items.headline: Theme announced for International Day of Yoga 2025
items.detail: PM Narendra Modi announced 'Yoga for One Earth, One Health' as the theme for the International Day of Yoga 2025. The first Yoga Day was observed on June 21, 2015.
examFacts: IDY 2025 theme: 'Yoga for One Earth, One Health'

items.headline: India adds a record 25 GW renewable capacity in FY25
items.detail: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy said India added a record 25 GW of renewable energy capacity in 2024-25, about 35% more than 18.57 GW added in FY24. Total installed power capacity stood at 483.26 GW as of March 2025.

items.headline: Paradip Port stays No. 1 among major ports in FY25
items.detail: Paradip Port in Odisha kept the top spot in cargo handling among India's major ports in 2024-25, handling 150.41 million tonnes, 3.5% more than in FY24. It was followed by Kandla Port in Gujarat.

items.headline: India makes record 1,681 locomotives in FY25
items.detail: The Ministry of Railways said India produced a record 1,681 locomotives in 2024-25, up 19% from 1,472 in FY24. This output was higher than the combined production of the USA and Europe.

items.headline: Biography of Lal Bahadur Shastri by Sanjeev Chopra released
items.detail: 'The Great Conciliator: Lal Bahadur Shastri and the Transformation of India', written by historian and former IAS officer Sanjeev Chopra, was released. It is a biography of India's second Prime Minister.

items.headline: 'One State, One RRB' merger of Regional Rural Banks
items.detail: The Finance Ministry announced the 'One State, One RRB' plan, merging 26 Regional Rural Banks in 11 states from May 1, 2025. The number of RRBs falls from 43 to 28.

items.headline: Startup Mahakumbh 2025 held in New Delhi
items.detail: The second edition of Startup Mahakumbh was held from April 3-5, 2025 in New Delhi, inaugurated by Union Minister Piyush Goyal. A Rs 10,000 crore second Fund of Funds for Startups was announced.
examFacts: Rs 10,000 crore Fund of Funds for Startups

items.headline: India ranks 36th in UNCTAD frontier technology readiness index
items.detail: In UNCTAD's report, India was ranked 36th on the readiness index for frontier technologies, up from 48th in 2022. India ranked 3rd globally in R&D activity.

items.headline: India wins six medals at World Boxing Cup in Brazil
items.detail: India won six medals at the World Boxing Cup 2025 in Brazil and finished second in the men's medal tally. Hitesh Gulia won gold, while Uzbekistan topped the table with seven medals.

items.headline: DRDO tests Mk-II(A) laser directed energy weapon
items.detail: DRDO carried out a field trial of the vehicle-mounted Mk-II(A) Laser Directed Energy Weapon at the National Open Air Range in Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh. The system was tested at a range of about 3.5 km.
examFacts: Test site: National Open Air Range, Kurnool (AP)

items.headline: Telangana first state to implement SC sub-categorisation
items.detail: Telangana notified the Telangana Scheduled Castes (Rationalisation of Reservations) Act, 2025, becoming the first state to implement sub-categorisation of SCs. It classifies 59 SC sub-castes into three groups for reservation in education and jobs.

items.headline: Odisha becomes 34th state to implement AB PM-JAY
items.detail: Odisha launched Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana along with its Gopabandhu Jan Arogya Yojana and the Ayushman Vaya Vandana Yojana at an event in Cuttack, becoming the 34th state/UT to implement AB PM-JAY.

items.headline: Justice Dinesh Maheshwari heads 23rd Law Commission
items.detail: Former Supreme Court judge Justice Dinesh Maheshwari was appointed Chairperson of the 23rd Law Commission of India, succeeding Justice Ritu Raj Awasthi. The commission's tenure runs until August 31, 2027.
examFacts: Chairperson, 23rd Law Commission: Justice Dinesh Maheshwari

items.headline: Mohun Bagan Super Giant win ISL 2024-25
items.detail: Mohun Bagan Super Giant beat Bengaluru FC 2-1 in the final at the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan, Kolkata, to win the 11th edition of the Indian Super League. It was their second ISL title.
examFacts: Final: Mohun Bagan SG 2-1 Bengaluru FC

items.headline: Cricket confirmed for LA 2028 Olympics after 128 years
items.detail: The International Olympic Committee confirmed that cricket will return at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics with six teams each in men's and women's T20 events. Cricket was last played at the 1900 Paris Games.
examFacts: Format: T20, 6 teams each (men and women)

items.headline: Justice B.R. Gavai named as the 52nd Chief Justice of India
items.detail: Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai was set to take oath as the 52nd Chief Justice of India on May 14, 2025, after CJI Sanjiv Khanna retires on May 13. He will serve until November 23, 2025 and will be the second Dalit CJI after Justice K.G. Balakrishnan.

items.headline: USA remains India's largest trading partner in FY25
items.detail: Commerce Ministry data showed the USA was India's largest trading partner for the 4th year in a row in 2024-25, with bilateral trade of USD 131.84 billion. China was second at USD 127.7 billion.

items.headline: Bhagavad Gita and Natyashastra added to UNESCO Memory of the World
items.detail: Manuscripts of the Bhagavad Gita and Bharat Muni's Natyashastra were added to UNESCO's Memory of the World Register. India now has 14 inscriptions on the register.

items.headline: Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor at Kalpakkam to be operational by 2026
items.detail: The Department of Atomic Energy said India's first 500 MW Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor at Kalpakkam, Tamil Nadu, is expected to reach first criticality by March 2026 and be fully operational by September 2026. It marks the second stage of India's three-stage nuclear programme.

items.headline: Pope Francis dies at 88
items.detail: Pope Francis, the first Latin American head of the Roman Catholic Church, died in Vatican City at the age of 88. He had served as Pope since 2013, after the resignation of Benedict XVI.

items.headline: PM Modi visits Saudi Arabia
items.detail: PM Narendra Modi visited Saudi Arabia on April 22-23, 2025, his third visit to the country. He co-chaired the second India-Saudi Strategic Partnership Council meeting.

items.headline: Retail inflation falls to 3.34%
items.detail: India's retail (CPI) inflation fell to 3.34%, the lowest since August 2019. Food inflation eased to 2.69%.

items.headline: BSE marks 150 years; Rs 150 coin released
items.detail: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman released a Rs 150 commemorative coin, the BSE@150 logo and the BSE 150 Index to mark 150 years of BSE.

items.headline: RBI allows minors above 10 to run bank accounts
items.detail: From April 21, 2025, the RBI allowed minors aged 10 years and above to open and operate savings and term deposit accounts on their own. Banks were told to update their policies by July 1, 2025.

items.headline: Neeraj Chopra wins Potch Invitational in South Africa
items.detail: Neeraj Chopra won gold in javelin at the Potch Invitational in South Africa with a throw of 84.52 m, his first event of 2025 under new coach Jan Zelezny.

items.headline: SIPRI: India fifth-largest military spender
items.detail: According to SIPRI, global military spending crossed USD 2.7 trillion in 2024. India spent USD 86.1 billion and was the 5th-largest spender after the USA, China, Russia and Germany.

items.headline: Patama Leeswadtrakul elected BWF President
items.detail: Khunying Patama Leeswadtrakul of Thailand was elected President of the Badminton World Federation for 2025-2029, succeeding Poul-Erik Hoyer Larsen of Denmark. She is the second woman to lead the BWF.

items.headline: Guidelines for Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme launched
items.detail: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw launched guidelines for the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme with an outlay of Rs 22,919 crore over six years (FY26-FY32).

items.headline: India-US exercise Tiger Triumph-25 begins on Eastern Seaboard
items.detail: The 4th edition of the India-US tri-service Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) exercise, Tiger Triumph-25, began on April 1, 2025 and ran till April 13. Its harbour phase was held at Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, and the sea phase off Kakinada.

items.headline: MGNREGA wage raised to Rs 370 per day for FY26
items.detail: The Ministry of Rural Development revised MGNREGA wages for 2025-26. The average daily wage rose from Rs 349 to Rs 370 per person, effective April 1, 2025, with hikes ranging from 2.33% to 7.48% across states.

items.headline: Shirley Botchwey becomes Commonwealth Secretary-General
items.detail: Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey of Ghana took office as the 7th Secretary-General of the Commonwealth of Nations on April 1, 2025. She is the first African woman and the second woman to hold the post, succeeding Patricia Scotland of Dominica.
examFacts: First African woman in the post

items.headline: Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025 comes into force
items.detail: President Droupadi Murmu gave assent to the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025, which aims to improve the administration and management of waqf properties. The Act took effect in April 2025.

items.headline: Tahawwur Rana extradited to India from the US
items.detail: Tahawwur Hussain Rana, accused in the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks, was extradited to India from the United States on April 10, 2025.

items.headline: Brice Oligui Nguema elected President of Gabon
items.detail: Interim President Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema won Gabon's presidential election with about 90.35% of votes, as announced on April 13, 2025. He begins a seven-year term.

items.headline: Nobel laureate Mario Vargas Llosa dies at 89
items.detail: Peruvian novelist Mario Vargas Llosa, winner of the Nobel Prize in Literature, died in Lima on April 13, 2025 at the age of 89. His well-known novels include 'The Time of the Hero' and 'The Feast of the Goat'.
examFacts: Won the Nobel Prize in Literature

items.headline: India Justice Report 2025: Karnataka tops large states
items.detail: The fourth India Justice Report (IJR 2025), released on April 15, 2025, ranked Karnataka first among 18 large and mid-sized states in justice delivery with a score of 6.78. West Bengal ranked lowest.

items.headline: India-Uzbekistan exercise DUSTLIK-VI held in Pune
items.detail: The 6th edition of the India-Uzbekistan joint military exercise DUSTLIK was held at the Foreign Training Node, Aundh, Pune from April 16-28, 2025. It focused on counter-terrorism in semi-urban areas.

items.headline: Earth Day 2025 observed with theme 'Our Power, Our Planet'
items.detail: International Mother Earth Day was observed on April 22, 2025 with the theme 'Our Power, Our Planet'.

items.headline: Pahalgam terror attack kills 26; India suspends Indus Waters Treaty
items.detail: A terror attack at Pahalgam in Jammu and Kashmir on April 22, 2025 killed 26 people. In response, India suspended the Indus Waters Treaty, closed the Attari-Wagah border and expelled Pakistani military advisers.

items.headline: India signs Rs 64,000 crore deal for 26 Rafale-M jets
items.detail: India and France signed a government-to-government deal worth about Rs 64,000 crore for 26 Rafale-M (marine) fighter jets - 22 single-seat and 4 trainer aircraft. Deliveries will begin by the end of 2029 and finish by 2031.

items.headline: Government decides to hold caste census
items.detail: On April 30, 2025, the Union Government announced that caste enumeration will be included in the next nationwide census.

quiz.q: Who became the first African woman to serve as Commonwealth Secretary-General in April 2025?
quiz.solution: Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey of Ghana took office as the 7th Commonwealth Secretary-General on April 1, 2025.

quiz.q: How many Rafale-M fighter jets did India agree to buy from France in April 2025?
quiz.solution: The Rs 64,000 crore deal covers 26 Rafale-M jets: 22 single-seat and 4 trainers.

quiz.q: Which state topped the India Justice Report 2025 among large and mid-sized states?
quiz.solution: Karnataka topped IJR 2025 with a score of 6.78; West Bengal ranked lowest.

quiz.q: Who was appointed Chairperson of the 23rd Law Commission of India?
quiz.solution: Former SC judge Justice Dinesh Maheshwari was appointed, succeeding Justice Ritu Raj Awasthi.

quiz.q: Which club won the Indian Super League 2024-25 title?
quiz.solution: Mohun Bagan Super Giant beat Bengaluru FC 2-1 in the final in Kolkata.

quiz.q: To what amount was the average daily MGNREGA wage raised for FY 2025-26?
quiz.solution: The wage rose from Rs 349 to Rs 370 per day from April 1, 2025.

quiz.q: With the April 2025 additions, how many Indian inscriptions are on UNESCO's Memory of the World Register?
quiz.solution: The Bhagavad Gita and Natyashastra manuscripts took India's total to 14.

quiz.q: What was the theme announced for International Day of Yoga 2025?
options: Yoga for One Earth, One Health
quiz.solution: PM Modi announced 'Yoga for One Earth, One Health' as the IDY 2025 theme.

quiz.q: As per SIPRI, what was India's rank among the largest military spenders in 2024?
quiz.solution: India spent USD 86.1 billion and ranked 5th after the USA, China, Russia and Germany.

quiz.q: Under 'One State, One RRB', the number of Regional Rural Banks was reduced from 43 to:
quiz.solution: Merging 26 RRBs in 11 states from May 1, 2025 brought the total down to 28.

items.headline: World Laughter Day celebrated on the first Sunday of May
items.detail: World Laughter Day was celebrated on the first Sunday of May 2025. The day was started by Dr Madan Kataria, founder of the Laughter Yoga movement.
examFacts: Founder of Laughter Yoga: Dr Madan Kataria

items.headline: Government amalgamates 43 RRBs into 28 from May 1
items.detail: The government's 'One State One Regional Rural Bank' reform took effect from May 1, 2025, amalgamating 43 Regional Rural Banks into 28.

items.headline: Germany overtakes Japan as world's largest creditor nation
items.detail: Japan's Ministry of Finance reported that Germany had overtaken Japan as the world's largest creditor nation, with Japan's foreign net assets second for the first time in 34 years.
examFacts: Japan second after 34 years on top

items.headline: Bangladesh issues new banknotes without Mujibur Rahman's portrait
items.detail: Bangladesh's central bank introduced new banknotes of Tk 20, 50 and 1,000 that do not carry the portrait of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.

items.headline: Botswana gets WHO Gold Tier for HIV response
items.detail: Botswana was awarded the WHO's Gold Tier status in recognition of its progress against HIV, becoming one of the few countries so honoured.
examFacts: Award: WHO Gold Tier for HIV response

items.headline: Lt Cdr Yashasvi Solanki first woman Navy officer as President's ADC
items.detail: Lieutenant Commander Yashasvi Solanki became the first woman naval officer appointed as Aide-de-Camp (ADC) to the President of India.
examFacts: First woman Navy ADC to the President

items.headline: Delhi gets South Asia's largest grid-connected battery storage
items.detail: A 20 MW/40 MWh battery energy storage system (BESS) at Kilokari in Delhi became South Asia's largest grid-connected battery storage system.

items.headline: Ayush Nivesh Saarthi portal launched
items.detail: The Ayush ministry launched the Ayush Nivesh Saarthi portal, a single-window digital guide to attract and facilitate investment in the Ayush sector.

items.headline: First WHO Pandemic Agreement adopted at World Health Assembly
items.detail: The 78th World Health Assembly (May 19-27, 2025) adopted the world's first WHO Pandemic Agreement, aimed at better global preparedness for future pandemics.

items.headline: Luis Montenegro reappointed Portugal's PM
items.detail: Luis Montenegro was reappointed Prime Minister of Portugal after his centre-right alliance won the May 2025 general election.

items.headline: WADA re-elects Witold Banka as President
items.detail: The World Anti-Doping Agency re-elected Witold Banka as its President and appointed Chinese former Olympic champion Yang Yang as Vice-President.

items.headline: DRDO dedicates Quantum Technology Research Centre in Delhi
items.detail: DRDO inaugurated a Quantum Technology Research Centre at Metcalfe House, Delhi, to push research in quantum communication, sensing and computing for defence use.

items.headline: International Workers' Day observed on May 1
items.detail: International Workers' Day was observed on May 1, 2025. The day remembers the 1886 Haymarket affair in Chicago and honour the contributions of workers. In India, Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi launched the 'Odisha Shramik Sathi' app for the state's workers on the occasion.

items.headline: Top-level reshuffle in the Armed Forces from May 1
items.detail: A major reshuffle at the top of the Indian Armed Forces came into effect on May 1, 2025. Air Marshal Narmadeshwar Tiwari took over as the 49th Vice Chief of the Air Staff, Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit became the Chief of Integrated Defence Staff, and Lt Gen Pratik Sharma took charge as GOC-in-C of the Northern Command.
examFacts: Vice Chief of Air Staff: Air Marshal Narmadeshwar Tiwari
Northern Command chief: Lt Gen Pratik Sharma

items.headline: Angola President Joao Lourenco on state visit to India
items.detail: Angola President Joao Lourenco paid a state visit to India from May 1-4, 2025, the first visit by an Angolan President in 38 years. India announced a 200 million dollar Line of Credit for modernisation of Angola's armed forces, and three MoUs were signed. Angola also became the 123rd member of the International Solar Alliance.
examFacts: First Angolan presidential visit in 38 years
LoC: USD 200 million for defence modernisation

items.headline: WAVES 2025 summit held in Mumbai
items.detail: The World Audio Visual and Entertainment Summit (WAVES) 2025 was held from May 1-4, 2025 at the Jio World Convention Centre in Mumbai, inaugurated by PM Modi. With the theme 'Connecting Creators, Connecting Countries', the summit saw industry deals worth about Rs 1,328 crore and representatives of 77 countries endorsed the WAVES Declaration on artificial intelligence. The Indian Institute of Creative Technology (IICT) was also launched.
examFacts: Venue: Jio World Convention Centre, Mumbai
77 countries signed WAVES Declaration on AI

items.headline: India and UK sign cultural agreement
items.detail: India and the United Kingdom signed a Programme of Cultural Cooperation in New Delhi. It was signed by Culture Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat with UK Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy, who was on a visit to India from May 1-3, 2025.
examFacts: Signed at the National Gallery of Modern Art
UK side: Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy

items.headline: World Tuna Day observed on May 2
items.detail: World Tuna Day was observed on May 2, 2025 to raise awareness about the importance of sustainably managed tuna stocks. The day was designated by the United Nations.

items.headline: Meghalaya hosts Strawberry Festival
items.detail: Meghalaya hosted its Strawberry Festival on May 2-3, 2025. The state had produced about 1,220 metric tonnes of strawberries in 2024, making it one of the leading strawberry producers in the country.

items.headline: FIFA awards Women's World Cup 2027 to Brazil
items.detail: The 74th FIFA Congress in Bangkok voted 119-78 to award the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup to Brazil, rejecting the joint bid of Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany. Brazil became the first South American host of the tournament, which will feature 32 teams.

items.headline: International Leopard Day: India has 13,874 leopards
items.detail: International Leopard Day was observed on May 3, 2025. As per the NTCA's 'Status of Leopards 2022' report, India has 13,874 leopards, with Madhya Pradesh home to the largest population.

items.headline: FC Goa win Kalinga Super Cup
items.detail: FC Goa won the Kalinga Super Cup title, beating Jamshedpur FC 3-0 in the final at Bhubaneswar. Goa became the first club to win the Super Cup twice.
examFacts: Final score: FC Goa 3-0 Jamshedpur FC
First club to win the title twice

items.headline: Anthony Albanese re-elected Australia's PM
items.detail: Anthony Albanese's Labor Party won Australia's federal election held on May 3, 2025, winning about 70 seats. Albanese became the first Australian Prime Minister in about two decades to win a second consecutive term.
examFacts: First PM in two decades re-elected

items.headline: Yoga guru Swami Sivananda Saraswati passes away
items.detail: Renowned yoga guru Swami Sivananda Saraswati passed away at the age of 128. He was awarded the Padma Shri in 2022 and was known for teaching yoga for nearly a century.

items.headline: Oscar Piastri wins Miami Grand Prix
items.detail: McLaren's Oscar Piastri won the Formula 1 Miami Grand Prix on May 4, 2025. It was his third straight win of the 2025 season.

items.headline: Yemen appoints Salem Saleh Bin Braik as Prime Minister
items.detail: Yemen appointed Salem Saleh Bin Braik as its new Prime Minister on May 4, 2025, replacing Ahmed Awad bin Mubarak.

items.headline: First India-Maldives HADR exercise begins at Maafilaafushi
items.detail: The first High Level Joint Defence Cooperation exercise between India and the Maldives was followed by the first India-Maldives HADR exercise held from May 4-10, 2025 at Maafilaafushi, with INS Sharda participating. It aligned with India's MAHASAGAR vision for the Indian Ocean region.

items.headline: ADB's 58th Annual Meeting held in Milan
items.detail: The Asian Development Bank's 58th Annual Meeting was held in Milan, Italy from May 4-7, 2025 with the theme 'Sharing Experience, Building Tomorrow'. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman led the Indian delegation, and ADB President Masato Kanda attended. ADB had committed about USD 5 billion to India in 2024.
examFacts: ADB's 2024 commitment to India: about USD 5 billion

items.headline: China wins 14th Sudirman Cup title
items.detail: China won the Sudirman Cup mixed team badminton championship for a record 14th time, beating South Korea 3-1 in the final at Xiamen. India finished ninth.

items.headline: India launches first genome-edited rice varieties
items.detail: Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched India's first genome-edited rice varieties, 'DRR Dhan 100 (Kamla)' and 'Pusa DST Rice 1', developed by ICAR using CRISPR-Cas gene editing. The varieties follow the 'Minus 5 Plus 10' strategy of reducing inputs and raising yields.
examFacts: Varieties: DRR Dhan 100 (Kamla), Pusa DST Rice 1

items.headline: India's first inter-state cheetah corridor announced
items.detail: Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh announced India's first inter-state cheetah corridor covering about 17,000 sq km across 27 districts. The corridor links the Kuno, Gandhi Sagar and Mukundara Hills landscapes.
examFacts: Area: about 17,000 sq km in 27 districts
Links Kuno, Gandhi Sagar, Mukundara Hills

items.headline: Chairs of key parliamentary committees announced for FY26
items.detail: Dr Sanjay Jaiswal was appointed chair of the Estimates Committee for 2025-26, while Baijayant 'Jay' Panda was reappointed chair of the Committee on Public Undertakings.

items.headline: USTR report keeps India on Priority Watch List
items.detail: The United States Trade Representative released its annual Special 301 Report, which again placed India on the Priority Watch List over concerns related to intellectual property protection.

items.headline: RBI imposes penalties totalling Rs 2.52 crore on five banks
items.detail: The RBI imposed monetary penalties on five banks, together amounting to Rs 2.52 crore. ICICI Bank was fined Rs 97.80 lakh, Bank of Baroda Rs 61.40 lakh, Bank of Maharashtra and IDBI Bank Rs 31.80 lakh each, and Axis Bank Rs 29.60 lakh.
examFacts: Total: Rs 2.52 crore on five banks

items.headline: DRDO conducts stratospheric airship trial
items.detail: DRDO carried out the maiden trial of its stratospheric airship from Sheopur in Madhya Pradesh. The airship reached an altitude of about 17 km and flew for 62 minutes; it was developed by ADRDE.

items.headline: Prakash Magdum appointed NFDC Managing Director
items.detail: Prakash Magdum was appointed Managing Director of the National Film Development Corporation (NFDC) in early May 2025.

items.headline: Greenfield airports approved for Kota and Puri
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved greenfield airport projects at Kota in Rajasthan, costing about Rs 1,507 crore, and at Puri in Odisha, costing about Rs 5,631 crore.

items.headline: Cashless treatment scheme for road accident victims effective
items.detail: The Cashless Treatment of Road Accident Victims Scheme came into effect on May 5, 2025, providing cashless treatment of up to Rs 1.5 lakh per victim. The scheme is implemented by the National Health Authority.

items.headline: India named Country Champion at World Bank Land Conference
items.detail: At the World Bank Land Conference held from May 5-8, 2025, India was named a Country Champion. India's SVAMITVA scheme for rural property mapping was showcased at the event.

items.headline: TCS and IBM set up Quantum Valley Tech Park in Amaravati
items.detail: TCS and IBM announced the Quantum Valley Tech Park at Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, housing IBM's Quantum System Two computer with the 156-qubit Heron processor.

items.headline: UNDP Human Development Report 2025: India ranked 130th
items.detail: The UNDP's Human Development Report 2025 placed India 130th out of 193 countries with an HDI score of 0.685, in the medium human development category. Iceland topped the index with a score of 0.972. The report's analysis focused on the digital transformation driven by artificial intelligence.

items.headline: Friedrich Merz elected Germany's Chancellor
items.detail: Friedrich Merz was elected Germany's 10th post-war Chancellor, winning 325 of 630 votes in a second-round ballot in the Bundestag after losing the first round.

items.headline: March retail inflation at 3.34 percent, a 67-month low
items.detail: India's retail inflation (CPI) for March 2025 stood at 3.34 percent, the lowest in 67 months, as per a State Bank of India report.

items.headline: Operation Sindoor: forces strike nine terror camps
items.detail: On May 7, 2025, the Indian armed forces launched Operation Sindoor, striking nine terrorist camps in Pakistan and Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir in response to the Pahalgam terror attack. The strikes targeted camps of LeT and JeM using Rafale, Mirage 2000 and Su-30 MKI aircraft launched from Indian airspace. The tri-service briefing was given by Colonel Sofiya Qureshi, Wing Commander Vyomika Singh and Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri.
examFacts: Briefed by Col Sofiya Qureshi and Wg Cdr Vyomika Singh

items.headline: Rohit Sharma retires from Test cricket
items.detail: Rohit Sharma announced his retirement from Test cricket on May 7, 2025. He finished with 9,230 runs and 30 centuries in 123 Tests, having captained India in 24 Tests with 12 wins. He continued to be available for ODIs.

items.headline: Cabinet approves Rs 60,000 crore ITI upgradation scheme
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved the National Scheme for ITI Upgradation with an outlay of Rs 60,000 crore, along with five National Centres of Excellence for skilling. The scheme aims to skill 20 lakh youth over five years.

items.headline: Cabinet approves development of five new IITs
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved development of five new IITs at Tirupati, Palakkad, Bhilai, Jammu and Dharwad at a total cost of Rs 11,828 crore.
examFacts: New IITs: Tirupati, Palakkad, Bhilai, Jammu, Dharwad

items.headline: Chip-based e-passports rolled out nationwide
items.detail: India rolled out chip-based e-passports across the country. The passports carry an embedded RFID chip storing the holder's data, building on the PSP-V2.0 system piloted from April 1, 2024.

items.headline: Border Roads Organisation observes Raising Day on May 7
items.detail: The Border Roads Organisation (BRO) observed its Raising Day on May 7, 2025. The BRO, raised in 1960, builds and maintains strategic roads and tunnels along India's borders.

items.headline: Maharashtra launches Adishakti Abhiyan
items.detail: Maharashtra launched the 'Adishakti Abhiyan' campaign with an allocation of Rs 10.50 crore to mark the 300th birth anniversary of Ahilyabai Holkar, the 18th-century queen of Malwa.
examFacts: Marks 300th birth anniversary of Ahilyabai Holkar

items.headline: Nicaragua announces withdrawal from UNESCO
items.detail: Nicaragua announced it would leave UNESCO effective December 31, 2026. The decision came after UNESCO awarded its 2025 Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize to the Nicaraguan newspaper La Prensa.
examFacts: Trigger: La Prensa's 2025 Guillermo Cano Prize

items.headline: 12th Global Space Exploration Conference held in New Delhi
items.detail: The 12th Global Space Exploration Conference (GLEX 2025) was held in New Delhi from May 7-9, 2025. ISRO reiterated its plan to build the Bharatiya Antariksh Station, India's own space station, by 2035.

items.headline: CBI Director Praveen Sood gets one-year extension
items.detail: The government extended the tenure of CBI Director Praveen Sood by one year, keeping him in office till May 2026.

items.headline: Cardinal Prevost elected as Pope Leo XIV
items.detail: Cardinal Robert Francis Prevost of the United States was elected as Pope Leo XIV on May 8, 2025, on the fourth ballot of the conclave of 133 cardinals. He is the 267th Pope and the first Pope from the United States, succeeding Pope Francis who died on April 21, 2025.

items.headline: India and UK conclude Free Trade Agreement
items.detail: India and the United Kingdom concluded negotiations on a Free Trade Agreement, along with a Double Contribution Convention Agreement on social security. About 99 percent of Indian exports will get zero-duty access, and bilateral trade is targeted to double from around USD 60 billion by 2030.
examFacts: About 99 percent of Indian exports duty-free

items.headline: World Red Cross Day observed with theme 'Keeping Humanity Alive'
items.detail: World Red Cross Day was observed on May 8, 2025, the birth anniversary of Henry Dunant, founder of the Red Cross. The 2025 theme was 'Keeping Humanity Alive'. World Thalassaemia Day was also observed on May 8.

items.headline: Paras Defence and HevenDrones form hydrogen drone JV
items.detail: Paras Defence and Space Technologies announced a joint venture with Israel's HevenDrones, described as India's first hydrogen drone joint venture.

items.headline: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups expanded
items.detail: The expanded Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS) came into effect from May 8, 2025. The guarantee ceiling was doubled from Rs 10 crore to Rs 20 crore, with 85 percent cover for loans up to Rs 10 crore and 75 percent above it, while the fee for champion sectors was halved from 2 percent to 1 percent.
examFacts: Cover: 85 percent up to Rs 10 crore, 75 percent above

items.headline: Coal gasification agreements signed under Rs 8,500 crore scheme
items.detail: Agreements were signed on May 8, 2025 with Category-II winners of the coal gasification incentive scheme, including Jindal Steel and Power, New Era Cleantech and Greta Energy. The total financial incentive under the scheme is Rs 8,500 crore, supporting India's target of 100 million tonnes of coal gasification by 2030.

items.headline: Adani Green becomes first water-positive renewable energy IPP
items.detail: Adani Green Energy became the world's first water-positive renewable energy independent power producer, certified by Intertek. The company operates about 14 GW of renewable capacity.

items.headline: India and Chile sign Terms of Reference for CEPA
items.detail: India and Chile signed the Terms of Reference for a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement on May 8, 2025, with negotiations starting from May 26. The pact covers critical minerals and digital services, among other areas.
examFacts: Covers critical minerals and digital services

items.headline: University of York and University of Western Australia to open campuses at Educity
items.detail: The University of York (UK) and the University of Western Australia received approval to set up campuses at Educity in Navi Mumbai, each investing about Rs 1,500 crore.

items.headline: ITER central solenoid reaches key milestone
items.detail: The central solenoid of the ITER fusion project in France reached a key milestone, with first plasma targeted for 2033. India has supplied ITER's giant cryostat.

items.headline: INS Arnala delivered to the Indian Navy
items.detail: The first Arnala-class shallow water attack craft, INS Arnala, was delivered to the Indian Navy. Built by GRSE at L&T's Kattupalli shipyard, the 77.6-metre warship has about 88 percent indigenous content.

items.headline: Sarvam AI launches Bulbul v2 speech model
items.detail: Indian AI startup Sarvam AI launched Bulbul v2, an indigenous text-to-speech model supporting 11 Indian languages.

items.headline: SMBC to buy 20 percent stake in YES Bank
items.detail: Japan's Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (SMBC) agreed to acquire a 20 percent stake in YES Bank for about Rs 13,483 crore. As part of the transaction, SBI sold a 13.19 percent stake for Rs 8,889 crore.
examFacts: SMBC stake: 20 percent, about Rs 13,483 crore
SBI sold 13.19 percent for Rs 8,889 crore

items.headline: PMSBY, PMJJBY and APY complete ten years
items.detail: The social security schemes PMJJBY, PMSBY and Atal Pension Yojana completed ten years since their launch on May 9, 2015. Cumulative enrolments stood at about 23.6 crore under PMJJBY, 51 crore under PMSBY and 7.6 crore under APY.

items.headline: Fourth RIMES Ministerial Conference held in Colombo
items.detail: The 4th Ministerial Conference of the Regional Integrated Multi-Hazard Early Warning System (RIMES) was held in Colombo from May 7-9, 2025 under the theme 'Actionable Early Warnings and Climate Services for All'.
examFacts: Theme: Actionable Early Warnings and Climate Services for All

items.headline: India strikes Pakistani airbases; ceasefire agreed on May 10
items.detail: After Pakistan launched Operation Bunyan-al-Marsus on May 10, 2025, India intercepted a Fatah-II missile near Sirsa and struck Pakistani airbases including Nur Khan, Murid and Rafiqui. The two sides then agreed to stop military actions on May 10, 2025.
examFacts: Airbases struck: Nur Khan, Murid, Rafiqui

items.headline: World Migratory Bird Day focuses on bird-friendly cities
items.detail: World Migratory Bird Day was observed on May 10, 2025 with the theme 'Creating Bird-Friendly Cities and Communities'. International Day of Argania was also observed on May 10.
examFacts: Theme: Creating Bird-Friendly Cities and Communities

items.headline: Former ICAR chief Subbanna Ayyappan passes away
items.detail: Dr Trilochan Mohapatra's predecessor as ICAR Director General, Subbanna Ayyappan, was found dead at the age of 68. The agricultural scientist was a Padma Shri awardee of 2022.

items.headline: Akashteer system intercepted Pakistani drones during Operation Sindoor
items.detail: The Indian Army's Akashteer air defence control and reporting system successfully intercepted Pakistani missiles and drones during Operation Sindoor.

items.headline: National Technology Day marks Pokhran anniversary
items.detail: National Technology Day was observed on May 11, 2025, marking the anniversary of the Pokhran-II nuclear tests of 1998. The 2025 theme was 'YANTRA - Yugantar for Advancing New Technology, Research and Acceleration'.

items.headline: Asian Blitz Chess Championships decided at Al Ain
items.detail: At the Asian Blitz Chess Championships in Al Ain, UAE, Ivan Zemlyanskii won the open section and Alua Nurman won the women's section.

items.headline: India wins seven archery medals at Shanghai World Cup
items.detail: India finished second in the Archery World Cup Stage 2 at Shanghai (May 6-11, 2025) with seven medals including two golds. South Korea topped the table. Deepika Kumari won a bronze, and Madhura Dhamangaonkar won an individual compound gold.
examFacts: Second in standings; South Korea first

items.headline: Buddha Purnima observed; Sarnath relics shown in Vietnam
items.detail: Buddha Purnima, marking the 2,587th birth anniversary of Gautama Buddha, was observed on May 12, 2025. Vietnam hosted the international Vesak celebrations, and the sacred relics of the Buddha from Sarnath were displayed in Vietnam for the first time.
examFacts: Sarnath Buddha relics shown in Vietnam first time

items.headline: Virat Kohli retires from Test cricket
items.detail: Virat Kohli announced his retirement from Test cricket on May 12, 2025, after 123 Tests in which he scored 9,230 runs with 30 centuries. He had debuted in 2011 at Kingston, Jamaica, and captained India in a record 68 Tests. He continued to play ODIs.
examFacts: Most successful Indian Test captain (68 Tests)

items.headline: Porter becomes India's third unicorn of 2025
items.detail: Logistics firm Porter raised USD 200 million in a Series F round led by Kedaara Capital and Wellington Management, becoming India's third unicorn of 2025 with a valuation of about USD 1.1-1.2 billion.

items.headline: Starlink receives Letter of Intent from DoT
items.detail: Elon Musk's Starlink received a Letter of Intent from the Department of Telecommunications for a GMPCS licence to offer satellite internet in India, subject to 29 security conditions.

items.headline: Bhutan launches world's first national crypto tourism payment system
items.detail: Bhutan launched the world's first national-level crypto tourism payment system, allowing visitors to pay for services in cryptocurrency. The system was developed with Binance Pay and DK Bank.
examFacts: Partners: Binance Pay and DK Bank
World's first national crypto tourism payment system

items.headline: India's life expectancy estimated at 69.8 years
items.detail: Data released by the Registrar General of India for 2021 (covering 2017-21) put India's life expectancy at 69.8 years. The death rate stood at 7.5 per 1,000 population.

items.headline: Study says Ladakh holds 68 percent of India's snow leopards
items.detail: A study published in PLOS ONE estimated 477 snow leopards in Ladakh, about 68 percent of India's total of 709. Hemis National Park showed the highest density at 2.07 cats per 100 sq km.
examFacts: Ladakh: 477 snow leopards (68 percent of India)

items.headline: UP launches UP-AGREES and AI Pragya with World Bank support
items.detail: Uttar Pradesh launched UP-AGREES, a Rs 4,000 crore agro-industrial growth project across 21 districts backed by a World Bank loan of Rs 2,737 crore, and AI Pragya, which aims to train 10 lakh youth in AI skills. World Bank President Ajay Banga was present at the launch.

items.headline: Adani signs 5,000 MW hydropower MoU in Bhutan
items.detail: Adani group signed an MoU with Bhutan's Druk Green Power Corporation to develop 5,000 MW of hydropower projects in Bhutan.

items.headline: Hollywood director Robert Benton dies at 92
items.detail: Oscar-winning American filmmaker Robert Benton, director and writer of 'Kramer vs Kramer', passed away at the age of 92.

items.headline: Army concludes Exercise Teesta Prahar in West Bengal
items.detail: The Indian Army's Teesta field formation conducted Exercise Teesta Prahar in West Bengal, validating joint operations readiness across terrain.

items.headline: Neeraj Chopra appointed Honorary Lieutenant Colonel in Territorial Army
items.detail: Olympic champion javelin thrower Neeraj Chopra was appointed an Honorary Lieutenant Colonel in the Territorial Army, as per a gazette notification of May 13, 2025.

items.headline: Army and NDRF conduct Exercise Raahat in Nagaland
items.detail: Exercise Raahat, a joint disaster response exercise of the Indian Army and NDRF, was held from May 13-15, 2025 at Dimapur in Nagaland.

items.headline: QNB becomes first Middle East bank at GIFT City
items.detail: Qatar National Bank (QNB) opened a branch at GIFT City, Gujarat, becoming the first Middle East-based bank to set up a presence at India's international financial centre.
examFacts: First Middle East bank branch at GIFT City

items.headline: BrahMos facilities inaugurated in Lucknow defence corridor
items.detail: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh inaugurated the BrahMos Integration and Testing Facility and a Production Unit at the UP Defence Industrial Corridor in Lucknow. He also inaugurated India's largest Titanium and Supralloy Materials Plant, built by PTC Industries (Aerolloy), in the same complex.
examFacts: Location: Lucknow, UP Defence Industrial Corridor
Titanium and Supralloy plant built by PTC Industries

items.headline: Adani unveils India's first hydrogen-powered mining truck
items.detail: Adani group launched India's first hydrogen-powered mining truck at Raipur, Chhattisgarh, deployed for the Gare Pelma III coal block. The 40-tonne truck runs on a PEM fuel cell with a range of about 200 km.

items.headline: Tapti Basin Mega Recharge Project announced
items.detail: Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra announced the Tapti Basin Mega Recharge Project, billed as the world's largest groundwater recharge project, costing about Rs 19,244 crore with about 90 percent central funding.

items.headline: Cabinet approves HCL-Foxconn chip plant at Jewar
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved a Rs 3,706 crore display driver semiconductor plant at Jewar, Uttar Pradesh by HCL in partnership with Foxconn. It is the sixth unit approved under the India Semiconductor Mission and the first in Uttar Pradesh.
examFacts: Sixth unit under India Semiconductor Mission

items.headline: SIDBI report: MSMEs account for about 46 percent of exports
items.detail: A SIDBI report on MSMEs said Udyam registrations had crossed 6.2 crore, and MSMEs contributed 45.79 percent of India's exports in FY25.
examFacts: MSME share of exports: 45.79 percent in FY25

items.headline: RBI fines SBI and Jana Small Finance Bank Rs 2.72 crore
items.detail: The RBI imposed penalties of Rs 1.728 crore on State Bank of India and Rs 1 crore on Jana Small Finance Bank, together Rs 2.72 crore, for regulatory non-compliance.

items.headline: Ajay Kumar appointed UPSC Chairman
items.detail: Dr Ajay Kumar, former Defence Secretary, was appointed Chairman of the Union Public Service Commission, succeeding Preeti Sudan whose term ended on April 29, 2025.

items.headline: Justice Surya Kant appointed NALSA Executive Chairman
items.detail: Supreme Court judge Justice Surya Kant was appointed Executive Chairman of the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) on May 14, 2025.

items.headline: Kynan Chenai and Sabeera Haris win World Cup trap bronze
items.detail: Kynan Chenai and Sabeera Haris won the trap mixed team bronze at the ISSF Shotgun World Cup in Nicosia, Cyprus, beating Turkey 34-33.

items.headline: DST launches first CCU testbed cluster for cement sector
items.detail: The Department of Science and Technology launched India's first cluster of carbon capture and utilisation testbeds for the cement sector, with five testbeds including a pilot at Ballabgarh.

items.headline: India among top six in 6G patents: Bharat 6G conference
items.detail: At the Bharat 6G 2025 conference held on May 14, 2025, it was announced that India ranks among the world's top six countries in 6G patents, with Rs 300 crore approved for 111 test projects.

items.headline: DRDO develops nanoporous desalination membrane
items.detail: DRDO's DMSRDE laboratory developed a nanoporous desalination membrane for converting seawater to potable water, an advance for naval and remote applications.

items.headline: Bhargavastra counter-drone system successfully trialled
items.detail: The indigenously developed Bhargavastra counter-drone system, made by Solar Defence Aerospace Ltd, successfully completed trials at Gopalpur, demonstrating its hard-kill capability against drone swarms.

items.headline: India's first 3nm chip design centres opened
items.detail: Japan's Renesas Electronics opened India's first 3nm chip design centres at Noida and Bengaluru.

items.headline: Ayurveda Day fixed to September 23 every year
items.detail: The government announced that Ayurveda Day will be observed on September 23 every year instead of on Dhanteras. September 23 is the date of the autumnal equinox.

items.headline: OPEC sees India as third-largest oil consumer
items.detail: OPEC's monthly report projected India's oil demand to rise from 5.55 to 5.74 million barrels per day in 2025, keeping India the world's third-largest oil consumer.

items.headline: PayU gets RBI's payment aggregator approval
items.detail: PayU received the RBI's final authorisation to operate as a payment aggregator, becoming one of the few online payment firms with the licence.

items.headline: Major ports handle record 855 MT cargo in FY25
items.detail: India's major ports handled 855 million tonnes of cargo in FY25, up 4.3 percent from the previous year.

items.headline: IUCN lists world's 25 most endangered primates
items.detail: The IUCN released the 'Primates in Peril' report listing the world's 25 most endangered primate species, highlighting threats from habitat loss and hunting.

items.headline: World Food Prize 2025 goes to Mariangela Hungria
items.detail: Brazilian microbiologist Mariangela Hungria won the 2025 World Food Prize for her research on soil microbes and biological seed treatments that boosted yields of soybeans and other crops.

items.headline: International Day of Families observed on May 15
items.detail: The International Day of Families was observed on May 15, 2025, as designated by the United Nations to highlight the importance of families in society.

items.headline: UP expands ODOP list to 74 products
items.detail: Uttar Pradesh expanded its One District One Product (ODOP) list from 62 to 74 products, adding new items from various districts.

items.headline: FCI to sell extra 2.8 MT rice for ethanol
items.detail: The Food Corporation of India approved the sale of an additional 2.8 million tonnes of rice for ethanol production, taking the total to 5.2 million tonnes at a reserve price of Rs 2,250 per quintal.

items.headline: Kantar BrandZ 2025: Apple tops; four Indian firms in top 100
items.detail: Kantar's BrandZ 2025 ranking placed Apple first with a brand value of about USD 1.3 trillion. Among Indian companies, TCS ranked 45th, HDFC Bank 56th, Airtel 66th and Infosys 73rd.

items.headline: India and EU launch research initiatives worth Rs 391 crore
items.detail: Under the India-EU Trade and Technology Council, two research initiatives worth Rs 391 crore (about 41 million euro) were launched, focusing on marine plastic litter and waste-to-green-hydrogen technologies.

items.headline: UN report projects 6.3 percent growth for India in 2025
items.detail: The UN's World Economic Situation and Prospects (WESP) mid-2025 update projected India's GDP growth at 6.3 percent for calendar year 2025, making it the fastest-growing major economy.

items.headline: Maharashtra tops Khelo India Youth Games 2025
items.detail: The Khelo India Youth Games 2025, held from May 4-15 in Bihar (with Delhi hosting cycling), concluded with Maharashtra topping the medal table at 158 medals including 58 gold. Haryana was second with 117 medals and Rajasthan third with 60.

items.headline: Rajon ki Baoli restored in Delhi
items.detail: The Archaeological Survey of India, with World Monuments Fund India and the TCS Foundation, completed the restoration of Rajon ki Baoli in Mehrauli, Delhi, a stepwell built around 1506.

items.headline: Rajasthan's Sangri gets GI tag
items.detail: Rajasthan's 'Sangri', the pods of the Khejri tree used in Rajasthani cuisine, received the Geographical Indication tag. The application was filed by SKRAU, Bikaner.

items.headline: BEL secures Rs 572 crore in orders for drone detection system
items.detail: Bharat Electronics Ltd said it received orders worth Rs 572 crore since April 7 for the Integrated Drone Detection and Interdiction System (IDDIS).

items.headline: MSCI adds Coromandel International and Nykaa
items.detail: Coromandel International and Nykaa were included in the MSCI Global Standard Index in its May 2025 review.

items.headline: Cristiano Ronaldo tops Forbes athlete earnings list
items.detail: Forbes' list of the world's highest-paid athletes was topped by footballer Cristiano Ronaldo with earnings of USD 275 million.

items.headline: L R Srihari becomes India's 86th chess grandmaster
items.detail: L R Srihari earned his final grandmaster norm to become India's 86th chess grandmaster on May 15, 2025.

items.headline: PSBs post record FY25 profit of Rs 1.78 lakh crore
items.detail: Public sector banks reported a record combined net profit of Rs 1,78,364 crore for FY25, up 26 percent year on year. SBI earned the highest profit of Rs 70,901 crore, while PNB's profit jumped 102 percent to Rs 16,630 crore.
examFacts: Total PSB profit FY25: Rs 1,78,364 crore (+26 percent)

items.headline: Bhuwan Ribhu first Indian to win WJA Medal of Honour
items.detail: Lawyer Bhuwan Ribhu became the first Indian to receive the World Jurist Association's Medal of Honour, presented at the World Law Congress in the Dominican Republic.
examFacts: Presented at: World Law Congress, Dominican Republic

items.headline: 58th Jnanpith Award presented to Ramabhadracharya and Gulzar
items.detail: President Droupadi Murmu presented the 58th Jnanpith Award for 2023 at Vigyan Bhawan on May 16, 2025. Jagadguru Ramabhadracharya received it for Sanskrit and Gulzar for Urdu.

items.headline: India's first publicly funded bio-foundry launched
items.detail: The Department of Science and Technology and ICGEB launched India's first publicly funded bio-foundry, which will help engineer biological systems for industrial use.
examFacts: First publicly funded bio-foundry in India

items.headline: Samudrayaan crewed dive targeted by end-2026
items.detail: The National Institute of Ocean Technology said the Samudrayaan mission aims to take three crew members in the Matsya 6000 submersible to a depth of 6,000 metres by end-2026, with a 500-metre dive trial planned by end-2025.

items.headline: India gifts 15 electric vehicles to Nepal
items.detail: India gifted 15 electric vehicles to Nepal on the sidelines of the Sagarmatha Sambaad held in Kathmandu from May 16-18, 2025.

items.headline: Commemorative stamp marks 125 years of Kodaikanal Solar Observatory
items.detail: A commemorative postage stamp was released to mark 125 years of the Kodaikanal Solar Observatory, which was established on April 1, 1899 and is India's oldest astronomical observatory.

items.headline: First monthly PLFS bulletin released
items.detail: The statistics ministry released its first monthly bulletin of the Periodic Labour Force Survey, for April 2025. It showed an unemployment rate of 5.1 percent, with LFPR at 55.6 percent and WPR at 52.8 percent (current weekly status).

items.headline: Daneshvar and Song Yuxin win Asian Chess titles
items.detail: Iran's Bardiya Daneshvar won the open section and China's Song Yuxin the women's section of the Asian Chess Championship at Al Ain (May 6-16, 2025). India's Nihal Sarin finished second in the open event on tiebreak.

items.headline: Zhu Jiner wins FIDE Women's Grand Prix overall
items.detail: China's Zhu Jiner won the overall FIDE Women's Grand Prix 2024-25 title, while India's Koneru Humpy finished fourth overall.

items.headline: Neeraj Chopra breaks 90m with personal best in Doha
items.detail: Neeraj Chopra threw a personal best 90.23 metres to finish second at the Doha Diamond League on May 16, 2025. Germany's Julian Weber won with 91.06 metres. Parul Chaudhary set a national record of 9:13.39 in the women's 3000m steeplechase.

items.headline: Sikkim celebrates 50 years of statehood
items.detail: Sikkim celebrated its 50th Statehood Day, marking five decades since it became India's 22nd state in 1975. PM Modi attended the golden jubilee celebrations.

items.headline: World Telecommunication Day marks ITU's 160th anniversary
items.detail: World Telecommunication and Information Society Day was observed on May 17, 2025, coinciding with the 160th anniversary of the International Telecommunication Union. The theme was 'Gender Equality in Digital Transformation'.
examFacts: Theme: Gender Equality in Digital Transformation

items.headline: Alcaraz and Paolini win Italian Open titles
items.detail: Carlos Alcaraz beat Jannik Sinner to win his first Italian Open title, while Jasmine Paolini won the women's singles and also the women's doubles at Rome.
examFacts: Women's champion: Jasmine Paolini (singles and doubles)

items.headline: Revamped OCI portal launched
items.detail: Home Minister Amit Shah launched the revamped Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) portal, streamlining registration and services for about 5 million OCI cardholders.

items.headline: GeM launches GeMAI, public sector's first AI chatbot
items.detail: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) launched GeMAI, India's first AI-powered chatbot in the public sector, on its 8th Incorporation Day (May 19, 2025).

items.headline: Nepal's Yala glacier declared dead at Asia's first glacier funeral
items.detail: Nepal's Yala Glacier was declared dead at a ceremony organised with ICIMOD, described as Asia's first glacier 'funeral'. The glacier lost 66 percent of its ice volume and retreated 784 metres since the 1970s, joining a small group of world glaciers formally mourned after Iceland's Okjokull (2019) and Mexico's Ayoloco (2021).
examFacts: Third glacier worldwide to be mourned

items.headline: World's first commercial-scale e-methanol plant opens in Denmark
items.detail: The world's first commercial-scale e-methanol plant began operations at Kasso, Denmark, built by European Energy with Mitsui, with an annual capacity of 42,000 tonnes.

items.headline: SEBI lowers e-book provider threshold for debt issues
items.detail: SEBI made it mandatory for debt issues of Rs 20 crore and above to use the Electronic Book Provider (EBP) platform, lowering the threshold from Rs 50 crore.

items.headline: Reliance Power ties up for 500 MW solar JV in Bhutan
items.detail: Reliance Power signed a joint venture with Bhutan's Druk Holding and Investments for a 500 MW solar project worth about Rs 2,000 crore, set to be Bhutan's largest solar venture.
examFacts: Capacity: 500 MW; investment: about Rs 2,000 crore

items.headline: Sansad Ratna Awards 2025 honour 17 MPs
items.detail: The Sansad Ratna Awards 2025 were presented to 17 MPs and two parliamentary committees for outstanding performance. MPs from Maharashtra won the largest share with seven awards.

items.headline: Dinesh Pant and Ratnakar Patnaik appointed LIC Managing Directors
items.detail: The government appointed Dinesh Pant and Ratnakar Patnaik as Managing Directors of LIC with effect from June 1, 2025.

items.headline: BRICS energy ministers meet in Brasilia; India targets 900 GW
items.detail: The BRICS Energy Ministers' Meeting was held in Brasilia on May 19, 2025, with India's delegation led by Manohar Lal Khattar. India noted an installed electricity capacity of about 475 GW and a 900 GW target by 2032, and will host the BRICS energy ministers' meeting in 2026.
examFacts: India to host 2026 BRICS energy meeting

items.headline: Kamil Idris appointed Sudan's Prime Minister
items.detail: Sudan appointed Kamil Idris, a former Director General of the World Intellectual Property Organisation, as its 16th Prime Minister.

items.headline: Bihar hosts first international buyer-seller meet
items.detail: Bihar held its first international buyer-seller meet on May 19-20, 2025, where a UAE-based Lulu Group signed an MoU, with focus on GI-tagged Makhana and litchi.

items.headline: India assumes APO chairmanship for 2025-26
items.detail: India assumed the chairmanship of the Asian Productivity Organisation (APO) for 2025-26 at its 67th Governing Body Meeting in Jakarta.

items.headline: CCI announces Digital Markets Division
items.detail: On its Annual Day (May 20, 2025), the Competition Commission of India announced the creation of a Digital Markets Division to oversee competition in digital ecosystems.

items.headline: MSDE announces apprenticeship pilot for North East
items.detail: The Ministry of Skill Development launched a North East Region apprenticeship pilot at Aizawl with Mizoram CM Lalduhoma. The Rs 43.93 crore scheme targets 26,000 youth and adds an extra Rs 1,500 per month to stipends.

items.headline: Mizoram becomes India's first fully literate state
items.detail: Mizoram was declared India's first fully literate state on May 20, 2025, with a literacy rate of 98.2 percent as per PLFS 2023-24. The achievement came through the ULLAS (New India Literacy Programme).

items.headline: International Booker Prize won by Kannada work 'Heart Lamp'
items.detail: Writer Banu Mushtaq and translator Deepa Bhasthi won the International Booker Prize 2025 for 'Heart Lamp', a collection of Kannada short stories. It became the first Kannada work and the first short-story collection to win the prize, and Banu Mushtaq is the first Indian Muslim woman author to be honoured. The two share the GBP 50,000 prize.
examFacts: First Kannada work and first story collection to win

items.headline: CCI clears Bajaj-Allianz deal and Temasek's Haldiram stake buy
items.detail: The Competition Commission of India approved the Bajaj group's acquisition of Allianz's stakes in their insurance JVs for about Rs 24,180 crore, and Temasek's purchase of a stake in Haldiram Snacks.

items.headline: Pankaj Advani wins third straight CCI Billiards Classic
items.detail: Pankaj Advani won the CCI Billiards Classic for the third consecutive year, beating Dhruv Sitwala 5-2 in the final.

items.headline: Nuclear pioneer M R Srinivasan and astrophysicist Jayant Narlikar die
items.detail: Two eminent scientists passed away on May 20, 2025. M R Srinivasan, former Chairman of the Atomic Energy Commission and a key architect of India's nuclear power programme, died at 95 (Padma Vibhushan, 2015). Astrophysicist Jayant Vishnu Narlikar, founder-director of IUCAA, died at 87 (Padma Vibhushan, 2004).
examFacts: Srinivasan: former AEC Chairman, Padma Vibhushan 2015, age 95
Narlikar: IUCAA founder, Padma Vibhushan 2004, age 87

items.headline: World Bee Day and World Metrology Day observed on May 20
items.detail: World Bee Day was observed on May 20, 2025, and World Metrology Day marked 150 years of the Metre Convention signed in 1875.
examFacts: Metrology Day: 150 years of the Metre Convention

items.headline: IB chief Tapan Kumar Deka gets one-year extension
items.detail: Intelligence Bureau Director Tapan Kumar Deka was given a one-year extension, keeping him in office till June 2026.

items.headline: Coinbase becomes first crypto exchange in the S&P 500
items.detail: Cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase became the first crypto company to join the S&P 500 index, replacing Discover Financial Services.

items.headline: Sagar Bhavan and Polar Bhavan inaugurated at NCPOR Goa
items.detail: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju inaugurated Sagar Bhavan and Polar Bhavan at the National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research in Goa on May 20, 2025, during NCPOR's Silver Jubilee. Polar Bhavan, built at Rs 55 crore, houses India's first Polar and Ocean Museum.
examFacts: India's first Polar and Ocean Museum

items.headline: India to chair IORA from 2025-27
items.detail: At the 24th IORA Council of Ministers' meeting in Colombo (May 21, 2025), Sri Lanka took over as Chair and India was appointed Vice-Chair, set to chair the Indian Ocean Rim Association for 2025-27. The meeting adopted the Colombo Communique.

items.headline: DoT launches Financial Fraud Risk Indicator; PhonePe first adopter
items.detail: The Department of Telecommunications launched the Financial Fraud Risk Indicator (FRI) under its Digital Intelligence Platform to flag mobile numbers linked to financial fraud. Payment firm PhonePe became the first to integrate it.

items.headline: Delhi airport is world's ninth busiest: ACI
items.detail: Airports Council International data showed Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport was the world's ninth busiest airport in 2024 with 77.8 million passengers, with Atlanta topping the list.

items.headline: USA becomes India's fourth-largest crude oil supplier
items.detail: Per energy data firm Vortexa, the United States became India's fourth-largest crude oil supplier, shipping about 0.33 million barrels per day in April 2025. Russia remained the top supplier with a 37.8 percent share.
examFacts: USA: fourth-largest supplier (0.33 mbd in April)

items.headline: IIFT to open first offshore campus in Dubai
items.detail: The Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) announced its first offshore campus at Dubai, expanding the footprint of Indian institutes abroad.

items.headline: International Tea Day and National Anti-Terrorism Day observed
items.detail: International Tea Day was observed on May 21, 2025, the sixth time since the UN designation. National Anti-Terrorism Day was also observed on May 21, marking the assassination anniversary of former PM Rajiv Gandhi in 1991. The Global Terrorism Index 2025 ranked India 14th.
examFacts: Anti-Terrorism Day marks Rajiv Gandhi's 1991 assassination

items.headline: INSV Kaundinya, ancient stitched sail ship, inducted into Navy
items.detail: INSV Kaundinya, a stitched wooden sail ship rebuilt using ancient Indian shipbuilding techniques and inspired by a ship depicted in Ajanta cave paintings, was inducted into the Indian Navy at Karwar on May 21, 2025 by Culture Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat.
examFacts: Design inspired by Ajanta cave paintings

items.headline: e-Zero FIR launched for big cyber frauds
items.detail: The I4C wing of the Home Ministry launched e-Zero FIR as a pilot in Delhi. Cyber financial fraud complaints above Rs 10 lakh are automatically converted into zero FIRs for swift police action.
examFacts: Applies to frauds above Rs 10 lakh

items.headline: Asiatic lion population rises to 891
items.detail: The 16th Asiatic Lion Census (May 10-13, 2025) counted 891 lions in Gujarat, up 32.2 percent from 674 in 2020. Amreli district recorded the highest count of 339 lions. The results were announced by CM Bhupendra Patel.

items.headline: US unveils USD 175 billion Golden Dome missile shield plan
items.detail: US President Donald Trump announced the 'Golden Dome' missile defence programme, a USD 175 billion shield targeted for completion by 2029, to be led by General Michael Guetlein.

items.headline: International Day for Biological Diversity observed
items.detail: The International Day for Biological Diversity was observed on May 22, 2025 with the theme 'Harmony with Nature and Sustainable Development'.
examFacts: Theme: Harmony with Nature and Sustainable Development

items.headline: PM Modi dedicates Rs 26,000 crore projects in Rajasthan
items.detail: On a visit to Bikaner on May 22, 2025, PM Modi dedicated development projects worth about Rs 26,000 crore, including 103 Amrit Bharat railway stations worth Rs 1,100 crore, and laid the foundation of the 100 MW Nawa solar project.

items.headline: MoHUA reserves 4 percent housing for persons with disabilities
items.detail: The Housing and Urban Affairs Ministry notified 4 percent reservation for persons with benchmark disabilities in allotment of General Pool Residential Accommodation (GPRA).

items.headline: Algeria joins BRICS-backed New Development Bank
items.detail: The New Development Bank announced that Algeria had joined as a member, with NDB President Dilma Rousseff making the announcement.

items.headline: Adani Defence partners Sparton for sonobuoy production
items.detail: Adani Defence and Aerospace signed a collaboration with Sparton, part of Israel's Elbit Systems, to make anti-submarine warfare sonobuoys in India.

items.headline: TIME100 Philanthropy list features Ambanis, Premji and Kamath
items.detail: TIME magazine's first TIME100 Philanthropy list included Mukesh and Nita Ambani, Azim Premji and Nikhil Kamath among the world's leading philanthropists.
examFacts: Featured: Ambanis, Azim Premji, Nikhil Kamath

items.headline: Mumbai 27th among world's wealthiest cities
items.detail: Henley and Partners' ranking of the world's wealthiest cities placed Mumbai 27th, with over 51,000 millionaires. New York topped the list.

items.headline: India lost 18,200 hectares of primary forest in 2024
items.detail: Global Forest Watch data showed India lost 18,200 hectares of primary tropical forest in 2024.

items.headline: Fitch raises India's medium-term growth potential to 6.4 percent
items.detail: Fitch Ratings raised its estimate of India's medium-term growth potential to 6.4 percent, citing strong fundamentals.

items.headline: NESFB renamed Slice Small Finance Bank
items.detail: North East Small Finance Bank (NESFB) was renamed Slice Small Finance Bank following Slice's acquisition of a majority stake.
examFacts: New name: Slice Small Finance Bank

items.headline: CSIR-NAL conducts HAPS flight tests
items.detail: CSIR-NAL carried out flight trials of its High Altitude Platform Station (HAPS) from May 8-13, 2025 at Challakere, with the subscale vehicle flying up to about 24,000 feet.

items.headline: JNCASR develops fast-charging sodium-ion battery
items.detail: Researchers at JNCASR, Bengaluru developed a sodium-ion battery that charges to 80 percent in six minutes and retains capacity over 3,000 cycles, offering a costlier-metal-free alternative to lithium batteries.

items.headline: New marine nematode species discovered off Tamil Nadu
items.detail: The Zoological Survey of India discovered a new species of marine nematode worm, named Pheronous jairajpurii, off the Tamil Nadu coast.
examFacts: Discovered by: ZSI, off Tamil Nadu

items.headline: Tripura gets integrated aquapark under PMMSY
items.detail: An integrated aquapark is being developed in Tripura under the PM Matsya Sampada Yojana with an investment of Rs 42.4 crore.

items.headline: PMAY-Urban completion deadline extended
items.detail: The government extended the deadline for completion of houses under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban to December 31, 2025.

items.headline: Food ministry launches Depot Darpan portal and Anna apps
items.detail: Food Minister Pralhad Joshi launched the Depot Darpan portal along with Anna Mitra and Anna Sahayata apps to improve foodgrain storage management and grievance redressal in the public distribution system.
examFacts: Apps: Anna Mitra and Anna Sahayata

items.headline: Obstetric fistula day and World Turtle Day observed
items.detail: The International Day to End Obstetric Fistula was observed on May 23, 2025 with the theme 'Her Health, Her Right', and World Turtle Day was also observed on May 23.
examFacts: Fistula day theme: Her Health, Her Right

items.headline: MP enhances Rah-Veer reward; big Omkareshwar project cleared
items.detail: Madhya Pradesh enhanced the reward under its Rah-Veer initiative from Rs 5,000 to Rs 25,000, and approved a Rs 2,100 crore project for developing sites linked with Adi Shankaracharya at Omkareshwar.

items.headline: Assam introduces AI news anchor ANKITA
items.detail: Assam became the first Indian state to introduce an artificial intelligence news anchor, named ANKITA, for its broadcasts.

items.headline: Maharashtra unveils first M-Sand policy
items.detail: Maharashtra announced its first policy on manufactured sand (M-Sand) to reduce dependence on river sand in construction.

items.headline: Jafar Panahi's film wins Palme d'Or at Cannes 2025
items.detail: The 78th Cannes Film Festival (May 13-24, 2025) awarded the Palme d'Or to Iranian director Jafar Panahi's 'It Was Just an Accident'. The jury was headed by Juliette Binoche and included India's Payal Kapadia. Joachim Trier's 'Sentimental Value' won the Grand Prix, Hasan Hadi's 'The President's Cake' won the Camera d'Or (a first for Iraq), and Neeraj Ghaywan's 'Homebound' screened in Un Certain Regard.
examFacts: Palme d'Or: It Was Just an Accident (Jafar Panahi)
Camera d'Or: first for an Iraqi director

items.headline: Justice K Somashekar appointed Manipur HC Chief Justice
items.detail: Justice K Somashekar was appointed Chief Justice of the Manipur High Court.

items.headline: Uttarakhand gets its first cycad garden
items.detail: Uttarakhand's first cycad garden came up in Haldwani, with support from JICA, housing 31 species of the ancient plant group.

items.headline: Kerala first state to make robotics compulsory for Class 10
items.detail: Kerala became the first state to make robotics mandatory for Class 10 students from the 2025-26 academic session. The module was developed by KITE and will reach about 4.3 lakh students.

items.headline: Li Shifeng beats Srikanth to win Malaysia Masters
items.detail: China's Li Shifeng defeated India's Kidambi Srikanth 21-11, 21-9 in the men's singles final of the Malaysia Masters badminton tournament.

items.headline: Neeraj Chopra wins silver at Chorzow meet
items.detail: Neeraj Chopra won the javelin silver with an 84.14 m throw at the Janusz Kusocinski Memorial in Chorzow, Poland, where Julian Weber won with 86.12 m.

items.headline: Bihar renames Gaya as Gaya Jee
items.detail: The Bihar government renamed Gaya district as 'Gaya Jee'.

items.headline: Bharat Forecast System launched: world's first 6-km weather model
items.detail: India launched the Bharat Forecast System (BFS) on May 26, 2025, the world's first global weather forecast model with a 6-km grid resolution, developed by IITM Pune. It runs on the supercomputer 'Arka' and was unveiled by Science Minister Dr Jitendra Singh.

items.headline: EPFO retains 8.25 percent interest for FY25
items.detail: The EPFO's central board decided to retain the interest rate on Employees' Provident Fund deposits at 8.25 percent for FY25.

items.headline: Apprenticeship stipends raised by 36 percent
items.detail: The 38th Central Apprenticeship Council approved a 36 percent hike in apprenticeship stipends, raising them to a range of Rs 6,800-12,300 per month.

items.headline: AM Green and Port of Rotterdam sign USD 1 billion green fuels deal
items.detail: AM Green signed an agreement with the Port of Rotterdam worth about USD 1 billion for green fuel supply chains. Green ammonia production at Kakinada is planned from the second half of 2026 with an initial capacity of 1 million tonnes.

items.headline: PAI 2.0 portal launched for panchayats
items.detail: The Panchayati Raj Ministry launched the Panchayat Advancement Index (PAI) 2.0 portal, rationalising panchayat assessment indicators from 516 to 147.

items.headline: NITI report seeks policy push for medium enterprises
items.detail: A NITI Aayog report titled 'Designing a Policy for Medium Enterprises' noted that medium enterprises make up only about 0.3 percent of India's enterprises and called for targeted support to help them scale.
examFacts: Medium enterprises: about 0.3 percent of total

items.headline: Nicusor Dan sworn in as Romania's President
items.detail: Nicusor Dan, an independent mathematician and former Bucharest mayor, was sworn in as Romania's President after winning 53.6 percent of the vote against George Simion.

items.headline: DRDO chief Samir Kamat gets second extension
items.detail: The Appointments Committee approved a second one-year extension for DRDO Chairman Dr Samir V Kamat, until May 31, 2026.

items.headline: YSR district renamed YSR Kadapa in Andhra Pradesh
items.detail: The Andhra Pradesh government renamed YSR district back to 'YSR Kadapa' through a government order issued on May 26, 2025, restoring the district headquarters' name in official usage.

items.headline: 47 new National Waterways targeted by 2027
items.detail: At a consultative committee meeting in Mumbai, Ports and Shipping Minister Sarbananda Sonowal said 76 National Waterways would be operational by 2027, including 47 new ones, with inland waterway cargo projected at 156 MTPA by FY26. The network is set to expand from 11 states to 23 states and 4 UTs by FY27.

items.headline: UGC approves five more foreign university campuses
items.detail: UGC approved five new foreign university campuses in India: Illinois Institute of Technology (the first American university), University of Liverpool, Victoria University, Western Sydney University and Istituto Europeo di Design.
examFacts: First American university: Illinois Institute of Technology

items.headline: Army gets its first community radio station
items.detail: The Indian Army launched 'Panchshul Pulse' (88.4 FM) at Pithoragarh, its first community radio station, under Operation Sadbhavana.

items.headline: Wings India 2026 curtain raiser held
items.detail: A curtain raiser event for Wings India 2026 was held, announcing that the civil aviation show will take place from January 28-31, 2026 at Begumpet Airport, Hyderabad.

items.headline: NIBE wins USD 17.52 million export order from Israel
items.detail: Pune-based NIBE Limited received an export order worth USD 17.52 million from Israel for universal rocket launcher systems with a 300 km range.

items.headline: Astra Microwave delivers first Surya radar to IAF
items.detail: Astra Microwave Products Ltd delivered the first Surya VHF radar to the Indian Air Force under a Rs 200 crore contract for six systems.
examFacts: Contract: Rs 200 crore for six radars

items.headline: Indrajaal Infra anti-drone system unveiled
items.detail: An autonomous wide-area anti-drone system called Indrajaal Infra was unveiled, capable of protecting areas up to 4,000 sq km.

items.headline: Pat Cummins releases memoir 'Tested'
items.detail: Australia's World Cup-winning captain Pat Cummins released his memoir 'Tested'.

items.headline: Kozhikode declares eight official biodiversity symbols
items.detail: Kozhikode became the first district in Kerala to declare eight official biodiversity symbols, covering a bird, butterfly, fish, tree, flower, and other categories.
examFacts: First district in Kerala with biodiversity symbols

items.headline: AMCA programme execution model approved
items.detail: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh approved the execution model for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, India's indigenous fifth-generation stealth fighter. The Aeronautical Development Agency will implement it with industry, and Indian companies may bid independently, as joint ventures or as consortia.
examFacts: Bidding: open to JVs and consortia

items.headline: PM Modi dedicates Rs 53,400 crore projects on Gujarat visit
items.detail: On a May 26-27 visit to Gujarat, PM Modi inaugurated the Dahod Locomotive Manufacturing Plant and flagged off the first 9,000 HP electric locomotives for domestic use and export, flagged off the Sabarmati-Veraval Vande Bharat Express, and dedicated projects worth about Rs 53,400 crore at Bhuj. He also launched Urban Development Year 2025 in Gandhinagar.
examFacts: Locomotives: 9,000 HP, first made in Dahod
Projects at Bhuj: about Rs 53,400 crore

items.headline: IMC 2025 theme unveiled; Sanchar Mitra scheme revamped
items.detail: Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia unveiled 'Innovate to Transform' as the theme of the 9th India Mobile Congress, to be held from October 8-11, 2025 at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi. He also launched the revamped Sanchar Mitra Scheme for student volunteers.

items.headline: ILO-NASK report: GenAI to transform one in four jobs
items.detail: A joint report by the ILO and Poland's NASK research institute said generative AI could transform about 25 percent of jobs worldwide rather than replace them. About 34 percent of exposed jobs are in high-income countries versus 11 percent in low-income countries, and 4.7 percent of women's jobs face the highest risk against 2.4 percent of men's.
examFacts: High-income share: 34 percent vs 11 percent low-income
Women at higher exposure: 4.7 vs 2.4 percent

items.headline: India's life insurance market to grow 10.5 percent annually
items.detail: The Allianz Global Insurance Report 2025 projected India's life insurance premiums to grow 10.5 percent annually over the next decade, against a 5 percent global average, making India Asia's second-largest life market, surpassing Japan. India's total premium income stood at about USD 145 billion in 2024.
examFacts: Life premium growth: 10.5 percent a year
To become Asia's second-largest life market

items.headline: Drools becomes India's fourth unicorn of 2025
items.detail: Pet food maker Drools, based in Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh, became India's fourth unicorn of 2025 with Nestle buying a minority stake, the Swiss giant's first-ever investment in an Indian brand. The valuation crossed USD 1 billion.

items.headline: FY25 gross FDI rises 14 percent to USD 81.04 billion
items.detail: India's gross foreign direct investment inflows in FY25 stood at USD 81.04 billion, up 14 percent from USD 71.28 billion in FY24. Services drew the most FDI (19 percent), Maharashtra led states with 39 percent, and Singapore was the top source at 30 percent.
examFacts: Top state: Maharashtra (39 percent); top source: Singapore (30 percent)

items.headline: National e-Governance Awards 2025 announced
items.detail: DARPG announced the National Awards for e-Governance 2025, the 22nd edition, with 19 initiatives (10 gold, 6 silver, 3 jury) and a new category for Gram Panchayats. The awards will be presented at the 28th National Conference on e-Governance in Visakhapatnam on June 9-10, 2025.

items.headline: Adille Sumariwalla gets Asian Athletics Leadership Gold Pin
items.detail: Adille Sumariwalla, World Athletics Vice-President and former AFI president, received the Asian Athletics Leadership Gold Pin at the Asian Athletics Association Congress in Gumi, South Korea.
examFacts: Award: Asian Athletics Leadership Gold Pin

items.headline: Prashant Thakker to head Citi's corporate bank for South and Southeast Asia
items.detail: Prashant Thakker was appointed head of Citigroup's corporate bank for South and Southeast Asia, based in Singapore.

items.headline: Intelsat approved for direct satellite broadcast services in India
items.detail: IN-SPACe approved US-based Intelsat to offer direct satellite broadcast services to Indian media organisations using four of its GEO satellites (IS-17, IS-20, IS-36 and IS-39), making it among the first foreign operators so approved.

items.headline: New cave fish species found in Meghalaya
items.detail: Researchers discovered a new cave fish species, Schistura densiclava, in Krem Mawjymbuin cave in Meghalaya's East Khasi Hills. Found 60 m inside the cave, the fish retains functional eyesight and pigmentation, unlike most cave species.
examFacts: Location: Krem Mawjymbuin cave, East Khasi Hills

items.headline: India tops ISSF Junior World Cup at Suhl
items.detail: India topped the medal tally at the ISSF Junior World Cup in Suhl, Germany (May 19-27, 2025) with 11 medals: 3 gold, 4 silver and 4 bronze. Tejaswani Sawant, Kanak Budhwar and Shambhavi Kshirsagar won the golds.

items.headline: Tim Wigmore's 'Test Cricket: A History' released
items.detail: British cricket writer Tim Wigmore released 'Test Cricket: A History', published ahead of Test cricket's 150th anniversary in March 2026, featuring interviews with stars including Sachin Tendulkar and Pat Cummins.

items.headline: Anil Kumble named Karnataka wildlife brand ambassador
items.detail: Former cricketer Anil Kumble was appointed brand ambassador of the Karnataka Forest and Wildlife Department.

items.headline: Google I/O showcases Gemini 2.5 and Ironwood TPUs
