items.detail: At its I/O 2025 developers conference, Google showcased Gemini 2.5 AI models, the Ironwood seventh-generation TPU delivering 5 exaFLOPS of performance, and media models Imagen 4, Veo 3 and Lyria 2.

items.headline: World Hunger Day and Menstrual Hygiene Day observed
items.detail: World Hunger Day (theme 'Sowing Resilience') and World Menstrual Hygiene Day (theme 'Together for a #PeriodFriendlyWorld') were observed on May 28, 2025. The International Day of Action for Women's Health was also marked the same day.

items.headline: Cabinet continues 1.5 percent interest subvention and raises kharif MSP
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved continuation of the 1.5 percent interest subvention under the Modified Interest Subvention Scheme for FY26 and approved two railway multitracking projects in MP and Maharashtra. The CCEA also approved an increase in MSP for 14 kharif crops for the 2025-26 marketing season.

items.headline: India's first AI SEZ coming up in Nava Raipur
items.detail: RackBank Data Centers will develop India's first Artificial Intelligence Special Economic Zone in Nava Raipur, Chhattisgarh, investing Rs 1,000 crore on six acres with a planned capacity of 80 MW across four high-density data centres.

items.headline: India's first private helicopter assembly line to come up in Karnataka
items.detail: Tata Advanced Systems and Airbus announced India's first privately-led helicopter final assembly line at Kolar in Karnataka to build the Airbus H125, with operations from 2026. It will be the fourth such line globally, with an initial output of 10 helicopters a year.

items.headline: RBI proposes 75 percent LTV cap on gold loans
items.detail: The RBI released draft guidelines for gold loans, capping the loan-to-value ratio at 75 percent and requiring proof of gold ownership, with uniform rules for banks and NBFCs.

items.headline: SBI Life and Vidyaniti buy 4.25 percent stake in NHIT
items.detail: SBI Life Insurance and Vidyaniti LLP jointly acquired a 4.25 percent stake in National Highways Infra Trust for Rs 1,100.61 crore from NHAI.

items.headline: SEBI bars former IndusInd Bank CEO for insider trading
items.detail: SEBI barred former IndusInd Bank CEO Sumant Kathpalia and four others, including former deputy CEO Arun Khurana, in an insider trading case related to unpublished price-sensitive information. Separately, Jio BlackRock AMC received SEBI's final approval for its mutual fund business.
examFacts: Barred: ex-CEO Sumant Kathpalia and four others
Jio BlackRock AMC: final MF approval

items.headline: Coal imports fall 7.9 percent in FY25
items.detail: India's coal imports fell 7.9 percent to 243.62 MT in FY25, saving about USD 7.93 billion in foreign exchange, while domestic coal output rose 5 percent.

items.headline: Sadhguru named Global Indian of the Year 2025
items.detail: Isha Foundation founder Sadhguru (Jagadish Vasudev) received the 'Global Indian of the Year 2025' honour from the Canada India Foundation in Toronto, with a CAD 50,000 prize dedicated to the Cauvery Calling initiative.
examFacts: Award: Global Indian of the Year 2025

items.headline: PepsiCo partners Formula 1 until 2030
items.detail: PepsiCo signed a global partnership with Formula 1 running until 2030, with Sting Energy as official energy drink and Gatorade as official partner of F1 Sprint races.

items.headline: Ahmedabad to host 2026 Asian Weightlifting Championships
items.detail: Ahmedabad will host the 2026 Asian Weightlifting Championships from April 1-10, 2026, the first time India hosts the event in 44 years (previously New Delhi, 1982).

items.headline: ADB pledges USD 10 billion for India's urban development
items.detail: ADB President Masato Kanda visited India from May 28-31, 2025, during which the Asian Development Bank pledged USD 10 billion in support for India's urban sector over the coming years.
examFacts: Pledge: USD 10 billion for urban development

items.headline: China launches Tianwen-2 asteroid mission
items.detail: China launched its Tianwen-2 probe on May 28, 2025 to collect samples from the near-Earth asteroid 2016 HO3, one of the world's most stable quasi-satellites.

items.headline: UN Peacekeepers Day, Digestive Health Day and Everest Day observed
items.detail: International Day of UN Peacekeepers was observed on May 29, 2025 with the theme 'The Future of the Peacekeeping', marking 77 years since the first mission (UNTSO) in 1948; India is among the largest troop contributors with over 5,300 personnel. World Digestive Health Day and International Everest Day, marking 72 years since the first ascent by Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay in 1953, were also observed.
examFacts: Peacekeepers theme: The Future of the Peacekeeping

items.headline: RBI Annual Report: balance sheet grows to Rs 76.25 lakh crore
items.detail: The RBI's Annual Report for FY25 showed its balance sheet expanded to Rs 76.25 lakh crore for the year ended March 2025.

items.headline: AyushSuraksha portal launched
items.detail: The Ministry of Ayush launched the AyushSuraksha portal to strengthen monitoring of adverse events and safety across Ayush systems of medicine.

items.headline: Florence Nightingale Awards presented to 15 nurses
items.detail: The National Florence Nightingale Awards 2025 were presented to 15 nursing professionals in recognition of their service.

items.headline: Srinath Raghavan's new book on Indira Gandhi released
items.detail: Historian Srinath Raghavan released the book 'Indira Gandhi and the Years That Transformed India', covering the period from 1966 to 1984.

items.headline: Goa becomes second fully functionally literate state
items.detail: Goa declared itself fully functionally literate on May 30, 2025, becoming the second state to achieve the status after Mizoram, which was declared earlier in the month.
examFacts: Second fully literate state after Mizoram

items.headline: FY25 GDP growth at 6.5 percent; Q4 grows 7.4 percent
items.detail: The National Statistics Office estimated India's GDP growth for FY25 at 6.5 percent, a four-year low, though the January-March quarter grew a strong 7.4 percent.

items.headline: Opal Suchata of Thailand wins Miss World 2025 in Hyderabad
items.detail: Opal Suchata Chuangsri of Thailand won the 72nd Miss World pageant held at HITEX, Hyderabad on May 31, 2025, becoming the first Thai winner.

items.headline: PSG crush Inter Milan for first Champions League title
items.detail: Paris Saint-Germain won their first UEFA Champions League title, beating Inter Milan 5-0 in the final at Munich.

items.headline: India and Mongolia begin Exercise Nomadic Elephant
items.detail: The 17th edition of the India-Mongolia joint military exercise Nomadic Elephant began on May 31, 2025, continuing bilateral defence cooperation.

quiz.q: Operation Sindoor, launched in May 2025, targeted how many terrorist camps in Pakistan and PoJK?
quiz.solution: Operation Sindoor struck nine terrorist camps of LeT and JeM on May 7, 2025, in response to the Pahalgam attack.

quiz.q: Who was elected as the 267th Pope in May 2025?
quiz.solution: Cardinal Robert Francis Prevost of the USA was elected Pope Leo XIV on May 8, 2025 - the first American Pope.

quiz.q: As per the 2025 census, what is the Asiatic lion population in Gujarat?
quiz.solution: The 16th Asiatic Lion Census counted 891 lions, up 32.2 percent from 674 in 2020; Amreli district had the most (339).

quiz.q: Which work won the International Booker Prize 2025?
quiz.solution: 'Heart Lamp', Kannada short stories by Banu Mushtaq translated by Deepa Bhasthi, became the first Kannada work to win.

quiz.q: What is India's rank in the UNDP Human Development Report 2025?
quiz.solution: India ranked 130th of 193 countries with an HDI of 0.685; Iceland topped the index.

quiz.q: Which country will host the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027?
quiz.solution: Brazil beat the Belgium-Netherlands-Germany joint bid 119-78, becoming the first South American host.

quiz.q: How many Test centuries did Virat Kohli finish with on his Test retirement in May 2025?
quiz.solution: Kohli retired from Tests with 9,230 runs and 30 centuries in 123 matches.

quiz.q: The Bharat Forecast System launched in May 2025 is the world's first model with what resolution?
quiz.solution: Developed by IITM Pune, the Bharat Forecast System runs on the 'Arka' supercomputer with a 6-km grid - a global first.

quiz.q: India's gross FDI inflows in FY25 stood at about how much?
quiz.solution: Gross FDI rose 14 percent to USD 81.04 billion in FY25; Maharashtra drew the most (39 percent).

quiz.q: Which became India's first fully literate state in May 2025?
quiz.solution: Mizoram was declared fully literate (98.2 percent) on May 20, 2025; Goa became the second state later that month.

items.headline: Census 2027 to be India's first digital census
items.detail: The government announced that the 16th Census will be held in 2027 in two phases with caste enumeration. The reference date is March 1, 2027 (October 1, 2026 for snow-bound areas), and it will be India's first digital census.
examFacts: 16th Census: two phases, with caste enumeration

items.headline: UN Sustainable Development Report: India enters top 100
items.detail: In the UN Sustainable Development Report 2025, India ranked 99th of 193, entering the top 100 for the first time. Finland topped the ranking.

items.headline: World Bank: India's extreme poverty falls to 5.3%
items.detail: A World Bank review using the new USD 3-a-day line showed India's extreme poverty fell from 27.1% in 2011-12 to 5.3% in 2022-23, lifting about 269 million people out of extreme poverty.
examFacts: New global line: USD 3 a day

items.headline: QS World University Rankings 2026 released
items.detail: MIT topped the QS World University Rankings 2026. IIT Delhi was the best Indian university at 123rd, and 54 Indian universities were featured.

items.headline: Energy Transition Index: India 71st
items.detail: India ranked 71st on the World Economic Forum's Energy Transition Index 2025 with a score of 53.3. Sweden topped the index.

items.headline: Global Peace Index: India 115th
items.detail: India was placed 115th in the Global Peace Index 2025.

items.headline: PGI 2.0: Chandigarh top for third year
items.detail: In the Performance Grading Index (PGI) 2.0 for school education, Chandigarh topped with a score of 703 for the third straight year. Meghalaya was at the bottom.

items.headline: India third with 64 unicorns
items.detail: India remained third in the global unicorn rankings with 64 unicorns.

items.headline: ILO: India's social security coverage rises to 64.3%
items.detail: An ILO report showed India's social security coverage rose from 19% in 2015 to 64.3% in 2025, making India second globally.

items.headline: EIU Liveability Index: Copenhagen top
items.detail: Copenhagen topped the Economist Intelligence Unit's Global Liveability Index 2025, while Damascus was ranked last.

items.headline: SBI pays Rs 8,076 crore dividend to government
items.detail: SBI paid a dividend of Rs 8,076.84 crore to the government for FY25.

items.headline: EPFO raises auto-settlement limit
items.detail: EPFO raised the auto-settlement limit for advance claims from Rs 1 lakh to Rs 5 lakh.
examFacts: Auto-settlement limit: Rs 1 lakh to Rs 5 lakh

items.headline: SEZ land rule eased for semiconductor units
items.detail: The government relaxed SEZ rules for semiconductor and electronics component manufacturing, cutting the minimum land requirement from 50 hectares to 10 hectares.
examFacts: Minimum land for such SEZs: 50 ha to 10 ha

items.headline: Tata Steel Gopalpur park joins WEF industrial clusters initiative
items.detail: Tata Steel's Gopalpur Industrial Park in Odisha became the first Indian industrial park to join the World Economic Forum's Transitioning Industrial Clusters Initiative.
examFacts: First Indian industrial park in the initiative

items.headline: South Korea elects Lee Jae-myung as President
items.detail: Lee Jae-myung was elected South Korea's 14th President on June 4, 2025 with 49.42% of the vote, after Yoon Suk Yeol's impeachment.

items.headline: Mongolia gets a new Prime Minister
items.detail: Gombojav Zandanshatar was appointed the 34th Prime Minister of Mongolia, replacing Oyun-Erdene who resigned.

items.headline: India sweep Asian Squash Doubles
items.detail: India won all three gold medals at the Asian Squash Doubles Championships in Kuching, Malaysia - men's, women's and mixed pairs. Joshna Chinappa and Anahat Singh won the women's title.
examFacts: India: gold in men's, women's and mixed doubles

items.headline: BSNL launches first indigenous Quantum 5G FWA service
items.detail: BSNL launched India's first indigenously developed Quantum 5G fixed wireless access service in Hyderabad.

items.headline: India's first Rare Donor Registry launched
items.detail: ICMR-NIIH Mumbai launched India's first Rare Donor Registry for donors with rare blood groups.
examFacts: First Rare Donor Registry: ICMR-NIIH, Mumbai

items.headline: India's first health-sector supercomputer inaugurated
items.detail: 'Nakshatra', India's first high-performance computing facility for the health sector, was inaugurated at ICMR-NIV, Pune.

items.headline: Telangana notifies Kumram Bheem Conservation Reserve
items.detail: Telangana notified the Kumram Bheem Conservation Reserve covering 1,492.88 sq km, strengthening the tiger corridor between the Kawal and Tadoba-Andhari reserves.

items.headline: CBSE to hold Class 10 board exams twice a year
items.detail: CBSE approved biannual Class 10 board exams from the 2026 session. The February exam will be compulsory and an optional May exam will allow score improvement.

items.headline: Operation Sindhu evacuates Indians from Iran
items.detail: India launched Operation Sindhu to evacuate its citizens from conflict-hit Iran; 517 Indians had been brought back by June 21, 2025.

items.headline: First Gender Budgeting consultation; outlay crosses Rs 4.49 lakh crore
items.detail: The first national consultation on gender budgeting was held, and a Gender Budgeting Knowledge Hub portal was launched. The FY26 gender budget is Rs 4.49 lakh crore.
examFacts: FY26 gender budget: Rs 4.49 lakh crore

items.headline: OPS benefits extended to Unified Pension Scheme subscribers
items.detail: The government extended old pension scheme benefits to Unified Pension Scheme subscribers, with a minimum pension of Rs 10,000 after 10 years of service.
examFacts: Minimum pension under UPS: Rs 10,000 after 10 years

items.headline: Clean Plant Programme to get nine facilities
items.detail: Nine horticultural facilities were announced under the Clean Plant Programme.
examFacts: Nine facilities under Clean Plant Programme

items.headline: UMEED portal launched for Waqf property records
items.detail: The central UMEED portal was launched for geo-tagging and digital records of Waqf properties, with boards required to register properties by December 6, 2025.

items.headline: DHRUVA policy for digital addresses
items.detail: The Department of Posts released the DHRUVA policy to create a digital address system built on the DIGIPIN geo-coded platform.

items.headline: Goa's Ozzo Feni gets first feni GI tag
items.detail: Ozzo Feni, made by Cazcar Distillery in Goa, became the first feni to receive a GI tag.
examFacts: First feni with GI tag: Ozzo Feni, Goa

items.headline: Tripura becomes third fully literate state
items.detail: Tripura was declared fully literate with 95.6% literacy, after Mizoram and Goa, under the ULLAS programme.

items.headline: Ladakh Official Languages Regulation promulgated
items.detail: The President promulgated the Ladakh Official Languages Regulation 2025, recognising English, Hindi, Urdu, Bhoti and Purgi as official languages of Ladakh.
examFacts: Five official languages: English, Hindi, Urdu, Bhoti, Purgi

items.headline: Greater Flamingo Sanctuary notified at Dhanushkodi
items.detail: Tamil Nadu notified a Greater Flamingo Sanctuary spread over 524.78 hectares at Dhanushkodi in Ramanathapuram district.

items.headline: Reliance Defence-Diehl Rs 10,000 crore ammunition pact
items.detail: Reliance Defence signed a Rs 10,000 crore agreement with Germany's Diehl Defence to make 155mm Vulcano precision-guided munitions in India.

items.headline: Javed Akhtar gets Russia's Dostoevsky Star
items.detail: Lyricist Javed Akhtar became the first Indian to receive Russia's Dostoevsky Star Award.

items.headline: Leena Nair honoured with CBE
items.detail: Chanel Global CEO Leena Nair received the Commander of the Order of the British Empire (CBE) honour.

items.headline: Shikhar Dhawan releases memoir
items.detail: Cricketer Shikhar Dhawan released his memoir 'The One: Cricket, My Life and More'.
examFacts: Book: The One: Cricket, My Life and More

items.headline: 'A Billion Butterflies' by Jagadish Shukla
items.detail: Meteorologist Jagadish Shukla authored 'A Billion Butterflies: A Life in Climate and Chaos Theory'.

items.headline: Marc Garneau dies
items.detail: Marc Garneau, Canada's first astronaut who later served as a federal minister, died at the age of 76.

items.headline: Former Zambia president Edgar Lungu dies
items.detail: Edgar Lungu, who served as President of Zambia, died at the age of 68.

items.headline: 81st IATA Annual General Meeting held in New Delhi
items.detail: The 81st IATA Annual General Meeting was held in New Delhi from June 1-3, 2025, hosted by IndiGo. Luis Gallego became the 83rd Chair of the IATA Board of Governors.

items.headline: World Milk Day
items.detail: World Milk Day was observed on June 1, 2025 with the theme 'Let's Celebrate the Power of Dairy'.
examFacts: Theme: Let's Celebrate the Power of Dairy

items.headline: Paraguay President visits India
items.detail: Paraguay President Santiago Pena visited India from June 2-4, 2025, as the two countries marked 64 years of diplomatic ties. An MoU establishing a Joint Commission Mechanism was signed.

items.headline: Global disaster risk platform meets in Geneva
items.detail: The 8th Global Platform for Disaster Risk Reduction was held in Geneva from June 2-6, 2025. IMD chief Mrutyunjay Mohapatra won the UN Sasakawa Award 2025 for disaster risk reduction.

items.headline: India's first government-funded multimodal AI model launched
items.detail: 'Bharat Gen', India's first government-funded multimodal large language model supporting 22 languages, was launched on June 2, 2025. It was developed under the National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems with IIT Bombay.

items.headline: India wins IIAS presidency after nearly 100 years
items.detail: India won the presidency of the International Institute of Administrative Sciences (IIAS) for 2025-28, getting 87 of 141 votes against Austria. DARPG Secretary V. Srinivas was elected President.
examFacts: IIAS presidency: first time in about 100 years

items.headline: RCB win their first IPL title
items.detail: Royal Challengers Bengaluru won their first IPL title in 18 seasons, beating Punjab Kings by 6 runs in the final at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad on June 3, 2025. Krunal Pandya was Player of the Match.

items.headline: Netherlands PM resigns
items.detail: Netherlands Prime Minister Dick Schoof resigned on June 3, 2025 after the PVV party quit the ruling coalition. A caretaker government is running affairs.

items.headline: World Bicycle Day
items.detail: World Bicycle Day was observed on June 3, 2025. It was first observed in 2018 after a UNGA resolution.

items.headline: Khichan and Menar wetlands declared Ramsar sites
items.detail: The Khichan wetland in Phalodi and Menar in Udaipur, both in Rajasthan, were declared Ramsar sites on June 4, 2025. India's total rose to 91, the highest in Asia and third globally.

items.headline: ECINET app launched by Election Commission
items.detail: The Election Commission launched ECINET, a single platform that brings together over 40 of its apps and shows real-time voter turnout updated every two hours.

items.headline: India elected to UN Economic and Social Council
items.detail: India was elected to the UN Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC) for the 2026-28 term with 181 of 187 votes.

items.headline: 4th India-Central Asia Dialogue held
items.detail: The 4th India-Central Asia Dialogue was held, with the foreign minister of Kyrgyzstan visiting India. Talks covered the Bilateral Investment Treaty and cooperation in rare earths and critical minerals.
examFacts: Focus: BIT, rare earths, critical minerals

items.headline: 92 Distinguished Service Awards presented
items.detail: 92 Distinguished Service Awards were presented at the Defence Investiture Ceremony (Phase-II): 30 PVSM, 5 UYSM and 57 AVSM.

items.headline: Five nations elected to UN Security Council
items.detail: Bahrain, Colombia, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Latvia and Liberia were elected as non-permanent members of the UN Security Council for 2026-27.
examFacts: New UNSC members for 2026-27: Bahrain, Colombia, DRC, Latvia, Liberia

items.headline: Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam 2.0 launched
items.detail: Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam 2.0 was launched on World Environment Day with a target of planting 10 crore trees.

items.headline: EnviStats India 2025 released
items.detail: EnviStats India 2025, the eighth edition of the environment statistics report, was released by the National Statistics Office.

items.headline: Rafale fuselage production to begin in Hyderabad
items.detail: TASL signed four production transfer agreements with Dassault Aviation to manufacture Rafale fighter fuselages in Hyderabad, the first such production outside France.
examFacts: First Rafale fuselage production outside France

items.headline: World Environment Day
items.detail: World Environment Day was observed on June 5, 2025 with the theme 'Beat Plastic Pollution', hosted by the Republic of Korea.

items.headline: PM Modi inaugurates Chenab Bridge, world's highest railway arch bridge
items.detail: PM Modi inaugurated the Chenab Bridge in Jammu and Kashmir's Reasi district on June 6, 2025. Standing 359 metres above the river, it is the world's highest railway arch bridge. He also inaugurated the Anji Khad Bridge, India's first cable-stayed railway bridge, and flagged off two Vande Bharat trains.
examFacts: Chenab Bridge: 359 m above the river
Anji Khad: first cable-stayed railway bridge
Projects in J&K: over Rs 46,000 crore

items.headline: Carlsen wins Norway Chess for the seventh time
items.detail: Magnus Carlsen won the Norway Chess tournament in Stavanger for the seventh time. D. Gukesh finished third, while Koneru Humpy was third in the women's event won by Anna Muzychuk.

items.headline: Piyush Chawla retires
items.detail: Leg-spinner Piyush Chawla announced his retirement from all cricket. He took 192 IPL wickets, joint third-most at the time.

items.headline: World Food Safety Day
items.detail: World Food Safety Day was observed on June 7, 2025 with the theme 'Food safety: science in action'.
examFacts: Theme: Food safety: science in action

items.headline: Alcaraz and Gauff win French Open 2025
items.detail: Carlos Alcaraz beat Jannik Sinner to win the men's singles at the French Open for the second time, while Coco Gauff beat Aryna Sabalenka for her first Roland Garros women's title.

items.headline: Portugal win UEFA Nations League
items.detail: Portugal beat Spain 5-3 on penalties after a 2-2 draw in the UEFA Nations League final in Munich to win the title for the second time.

items.headline: Sat Pal Bhanoo gets interim charge of LIC
items.detail: Sat Pal Bhanoo was given interim charge as MD and CEO of LIC after Siddhartha Mohanty's term ended on June 7, 2025.
examFacts: LIC interim chief: Sat Pal Bhanoo

items.headline: Mahendra Dev named EAC-PM Chairman
items.detail: Economist S. Mahendra Dev was appointed Chairman of the Prime Minister's Economic Advisory Council, succeeding Suman Bery.

items.headline: India slips to 131st in Global Gender Gap Report
items.detail: The World Economic Forum's Global Gender Gap Report 2025 placed India 131st of 148 countries. Iceland topped the index for the 16th time.

items.headline: Former Gujarat CM Vijay Rupani dies in plane crash
items.detail: Former Gujarat Chief Minister Vijay Rupani died in the Air India crash at Ahmedabad on June 12, 2025. He was Gujarat's 16th Chief Minister (2016-21).

items.headline: World Day Against Child Labour
items.detail: World Day Against Child Labour was observed on June 12, 2025. UN reports estimated 138 million children in child labour in 2024.

items.headline: South Africa win World Test Championship final
items.detail: South Africa beat Australia by 5 wickets in the World Test Championship 2023-25 final at Lord's to win their first ICC trophy since 1998. Aiden Markram was Player of the Match.

items.headline: Rudrastra hybrid UAV tested at Pokhran
items.detail: The Rudrastra, a hybrid vertical take-off and landing unmanned aerial vehicle, was test-flown at Pokhran.

items.headline: Exercise Khaan Quest begins in Mongolia
items.detail: The 22nd edition of the multinational exercise Khaan Quest began in Mongolia, with 24 nations taking part.

items.headline: World Blood Donor Day
items.detail: World Blood Donor Day was observed on June 14, 2025, its 21st edition.

items.headline: PM Modi's three-nation tour: Cyprus, Canada, Croatia
items.detail: PM Modi visited Cyprus, Canada and Croatia from June 15-19, 2025. He received Cyprus's top civilian honour, attended the 51st G7 Summit in Canada, and became the first Indian PM to visit Croatia.
examFacts: First Indian PM visit to Croatia

items.headline: India top medal table at Archery Asia Cup Stage 2
items.detail: India finished on top with 9 medals (2 gold) at Archery Asia Cup Stage 2 in Singapore.

items.headline: India third at ISSF World Cup Munich
items.detail: India finished third with 4 medals (2 gold) at the ISSF World Cup stage in Munich.

items.headline: George Russell wins Canadian Grand Prix
items.detail: George Russell of Mercedes won the Canadian Grand Prix on June 15, 2025.

items.headline: 55th Paris Air Show held
items.detail: The 55th Paris Air Show was held from June 16-22, 2025. The Rafale Marine programme was launched at the show on June 19.

items.headline: Bonn climate talks conclude
items.detail: The Bonn Climate Change Conference (SB 62) was held from June 16-26, 2025.

items.headline: INS Arnala commissioned
items.detail: INS Arnala, the first indigenous Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft, was commissioned at Visakhapatnam on June 18, 2025.

items.headline: Exercise SHAKTI between India and France
items.detail: The eighth edition of the India-France joint exercise SHAKTI was held at Camp Larzac, France from June 18 to July 1, 2025.

items.headline: Sahitya Akademi Yuva and Bal Puraskars announced
items.detail: The Sahitya Akademi announced the Yuva Puraskar 2025 and the Bal Sahitya Puraskar 2025.
examFacts: Announced: Yuva Puraskar and Bal Sahitya Puraskar 2025

items.headline: First artificial rain pilot approved for Delhi
items.detail: Delhi approved its first cloud-seeding pilot project to induce artificial rain, to be carried out with IIT Kanpur at a cost of Rs 3.21 crore.

items.headline: NIPCCD renamed after Savitribai Phule
items.detail: The National Institute of Public Cooperation and Child Development (NIPCCD) was renamed the Savitribai Phule National Institute of Women and Child Development.

items.headline: Neeraj Chopra wins Paris Diamond League and Ostrava title
items.detail: Neeraj Chopra won the Paris Diamond League javelin on June 20, 2025 with an 88.16 m throw, and followed it with the Ostrava Golden Spike title on June 24 with 85.29 m.

items.headline: HAL to build SSLV rockets under first full technology transfer
items.detail: HAL signed a Rs 511 crore agreement with ISRO on June 20, 2025 for the transfer of technology of the Small Satellite Launch Vehicle (SSLV). It is the first full rocket technology transfer to an Indian company, making HAL the country's third rocket maker.

items.headline: World Refugee Day
items.detail: World Refugee Day was observed on June 20, 2025 with the theme 'Solidarity with Refugees'.

items.headline: PM launches projects in Bihar, Odisha and Andhra Pradesh
items.detail: During his June 20-21 visit, PM Modi launched projects worth over Rs 24,400 crore across Bihar, Odisha and Andhra Pradesh, flagged off the 71st Vande Bharat train (Patliputra-Gorakhpur), and flagged off the first export locomotive from Marhowrah to Guinea.
examFacts: First export locomotive: Marhowrah to Guinea

items.headline: 11th International Day of Yoga
items.detail: The 11th International Day of Yoga was observed on June 21, 2025 with the theme 'Yoga for One Earth, One Health'. The national event was led by PM Modi in Visakhapatnam.
examFacts: Theme: Yoga for One Earth, One Health

items.headline: FedEx founder Fred Smith dies
items.detail: Fred Smith, founder of FedEx, died at the age of 80.

items.headline: Former spinner Dilip Doshi dies
items.detail: Former India left-arm spinner Dilip Doshi died at 77. He took 114 wickets in 33 Tests.

items.headline: India's first off-grid green hydrogen plant commissioned
items.detail: Adani's energy company commissioned India's first off-grid 5 MW green hydrogen pilot plant at Kutch, Gujarat.

items.headline: Dangeti Jahnavi named astronaut candidate
items.detail: Dangeti Jahnavi became the first Indian selected as an astronaut candidate by a private space company, Titan Space Industries, for its planned 2029 Orbital Port mission.
examFacts: First Indian selected by Titan Space Industries

items.headline: NATO leaders agree 5% GDP defence spending goal
items.detail: At The Hague summit on June 24-25, 2025, NATO members agreed to raise defence-related spending to 5% of GDP by 2035.

items.headline: First SMR-based nuclear plant for eastern India
items.detail: The government announced an SMR-based nuclear power plant in Nawada, Bihar, the first in eastern India, along with viability gap funding for 1,000 MW of battery energy storage.

items.headline: NAVYA pilot launched for adolescent girls
items.detail: The NAVYA pilot was launched in Sonbhadra, Uttar Pradesh to give vocational training to girls aged 16-18 who have passed Class 10.

items.headline: Passport Seva Divas
items.detail: Passport Seva Divas was observed on June 24, 2025, marking the Passports Act of 1967. E-passports were rolled out nationwide.

items.headline: Zou Jiayi elected first woman AIIB President
items.detail: Zou Jiayi, a former Chinese vice finance minister, was elected President of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, the first woman to hold the post. She takes office in January 2026, succeeding Jin Liqun.

items.headline: Axiom-4 mission launches with Shubhanshu Shukla
items.detail: The Axiom-4 (Ax-4) mission was launched to the ISS on June 25, 2025 on a Falcon 9 rocket, with the Dragon spacecraft 'Grace'. The crew included India's Shubhanshu Shukla as pilot, along with Peggy Whitson (USA), Slawosz Uznanski-Wisniewski (Poland) and Tibor Kapu (Hungary). It was the first ISS visit for India, Poland and Hungary.
examFacts: Crew from USA, India, Poland, Hungary

items.headline: Rajnath Singh attends SCO defence ministers' meeting in Qingdao
items.detail: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh attended the SCO defence ministers' meeting in Qingdao, China on June 25-26, 2025, and declined to sign the joint statement.
examFacts: SCO defence ministers' meeting: Qingdao, China
India did not sign the joint statement

items.headline: India's exports touch record USD 825 billion
items.detail: At the EXIM Bank Trade Conclave in New Delhi, it was announced that India's exports reached a record USD 825 billion in FY25.

items.headline: Cabinet clears Jharia master plan and potato research centre
items.detail: The Cabinet approved the revised Jharia Master Plan worth Rs 5,940.47 crore, a South Asia regional centre of the International Potato Centre in Agra, and Pune Metro Phase-2. It also marked the Emergency's 50th anniversary as 'Samvidhan Hatya Divas'.
examFacts: Potato Centre regional hub: Agra, UP

items.headline: Samvidhaan Hatya Diwas
items.detail: June 25, 2025 marked 50 years since the 1975 Emergency and was observed as Samvidhaan Hatya Diwas.

items.headline: Day of the Seafarer
items.detail: The Day of the Seafarer was observed on June 25, 2025 with the theme 'My Harassment-Free Ship'.

items.headline: AMRUT completes 10 years
items.detail: The AMRUT scheme for urban water supply completed 10 years on June 25, 2025.

items.headline: Tata remains India's most valuable brand
items.detail: Tata topped the Brand Finance India 100 list with a brand value of USD 31.6 billion.

items.headline: World Bank and IAEA sign nuclear energy pact
items.detail: The World Bank and the IAEA signed an agreement on June 26, 2025 to support nuclear energy in developing countries, covering knowledge sharing, extending reactor life and small modular reactors.
examFacts: Focus: nuclear energy for developing nations

items.headline: Green energy storage push: Rs 5,400 crore viability support
items.detail: A 5 GWh battery energy storage plant was inaugurated at Bidadi, Bengaluru, and an additional Rs 5,400 crore in viability gap funding was announced for 30 GWh of storage capacity.
examFacts: Extra VGF: Rs 5,400 crore for 30 GWh

items.headline: Salkhan Fossils Park on UNESCO tentative list
items.detail: Salkhan Fossils Park in Sonbhadra, Uttar Pradesh was added to UNESCO's World Heritage Tentative List. India now has 63 tentative sites.

items.headline: India's first wildlife-friendly expressway stretch
items.detail: A 12 km stretch of the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway through the Ranthambore buffer zone in Rajasthan became India's first wildlife-friendly expressway section, with five 500-metre overpasses and India's longest animal underpass.

items.headline: ESIC SPREE scheme relaunched
items.detail: ESIC announced the relaunch of its SPREE scheme, which lets employers declare previously uncovered employees, from July 1 to December 31, 2025.

items.headline: Aralam sanctuary renamed as India's first butterfly sanctuary
items.detail: Kerala renamed the Aralam Wildlife Sanctuary in Kannur, which was established in 1984 as India's first butterfly sanctuary.
examFacts: Aralam WLS: India's first butterfly sanctuary

items.headline: ICGS Adamya inducted
items.detail: The Indian Coast Guard inducted ICGS Adamya, the first fast patrol vessel of the 08-FPV project, built by Goa Shipyard Limited.
examFacts: ICGS Adamya: first FPV of 08-FPV project

items.headline: Safran to set up first Rafale engine MRO outside France
items.detail: Safran announced a maintenance facility for Rafale M88 engines in Hyderabad, its first such facility outside France.

items.headline: International Day Against Drug Abuse
items.detail: The International Day Against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking was observed on June 26, 2025 with the theme 'Break the Cycle. #StopOrganizedCrime'.

items.headline: 'The Emergency Diaries' released
items.detail: Union Minister Amit Shah released 'The Emergency Diaries', marking 50 years of the 1975 Emergency.

items.headline: Sagarmala Finance Corporation launched
items.detail: India's first maritime sector finance company, Sagarmala Finance Corporation (SMFCL), was inaugurated as a Mini Ratna-I CPSE.

items.headline: Two-wheeler ABS mandatory from January 2026
items.detail: The road transport ministry mandated anti-lock braking systems (ABS) on all two-wheelers made from January 1, 2026. Two BIS-standard helmets must also be sold with every new two-wheeler.
examFacts: ABS on all two-wheelers from January 1, 2026
Two helmets with every new two-wheeler

items.headline: India's external debt at USD 736.3 billion
items.detail: India's external debt stood at USD 736.3 billion at the end of March 2025, as reported on June 27, 2025.

items.headline: India posts Q4 current account surplus
items.detail: RBI data showed a current account surplus of USD 13.5 billion (1.3% of GDP) in Q4 of FY25. The full-year current account deficit narrowed to USD 23.3 billion (0.6% of GDP).
examFacts: Q4 FY25: surplus of USD 13.5 billion

items.headline: Public sector banks post record profit
items.detail: At the annual review meeting, the government said public sector banks earned a record net profit of about Rs 1.78 lakh crore in FY25.
examFacts: PSB net profit FY25: about Rs 1.78 lakh crore

items.headline: Praggnanandhaa wins UzChess Cup
items.detail: R. Praggnanandhaa won the second UzChess Cup Masters in Tashkent, beating Nodirbek Abdusattorov. The 19-year-old became India's number one and world number four by live rating.

items.headline: Hockey India Masters Cup winners
items.detail: In the Hockey India Masters Cup, Odisha won the women's title and Tamil Nadu won the men's title.

items.headline: ICC's new playing conditions from July 2
items.detail: New ICC playing conditions came into effect from July 2, 2025, including the use of the stop clock in Test cricket.
examFacts: Stop clock extended to Tests from July 2, 2025

items.headline: World MSME Day
items.detail: World MSME Day was observed on June 27, 2025, with a national 'Udyami Bharat' programme presided over by President Droupadi Murmu.

items.headline: First International Day of Deafblindness
items.detail: The first-ever International Day of Deafblindness was observed on June 27, 2025, marking Helen Keller's 145th birth anniversary.

items.headline: Bihar first state with mobile e-voting
items.detail: Bihar became the first Indian state to use mobile e-voting for urban body polls, through the e-Voting SECBHR app developed by C-DAC.

items.headline: National Insurance Awareness Day
items.detail: National Insurance Awareness Day was observed on June 28, 2025. India's first life insurer, the Oriental Life Insurance Company, was set up in 1818 in Kolkata.
examFacts: First Indian life insurer: Oriental Life Insurance Company (1818, Kolkata)

items.headline: Norris wins Austrian Grand Prix
items.detail: Lando Norris won the Austrian Grand Prix on June 29, 2025.

items.headline: Statistics Day
items.detail: Statistics Day was observed on June 29, 2025 marking the birth anniversary of P.C. Mahalanobis, with the theme '75 Years of NSS'.

items.headline: WHO certifies Suriname malaria-free
items.detail: The WHO certified Suriname as malaria-free on June 30, 2025.

quiz.q: After the June 2025 additions, how many Ramsar sites does India have?
quiz.solution: Khichan and Menar in Rajasthan were added in June 2025, taking India's total to 91 - the highest in Asia.

quiz.q: What is special about Census 2027 announced in June 2025?
options: It will be India's first digital census
It will be held only in cities
It will be a sample survey
quiz.solution: The 16th Census (2027) will be a two-phase, first-ever digital census with caste enumeration; reference date March 1, 2027.

quiz.q: Who was the pilot of the Axiom-4 mission that launched on June 25, 2025?
quiz.solution: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla served as pilot of Ax-4, the first ISS visit for India, Poland and Hungary.

quiz.q: Which country topped the WEF Global Gender Gap Report 2025?
quiz.solution: Iceland topped the index for the 16th time; India was placed 131st of 148.

quiz.q: Who won the second UzChess Cup Masters in June 2025?
quiz.solution: Praggnanandhaa won in Tashkent, becoming India No. 1 and world No. 4 by live rating.

quiz.q: Which team won its first-ever IPL title in the 2025 season?
quiz.solution: RCB beat Punjab Kings by 6 runs in the final at Ahmedabad on June 3, 2025.

quiz.q: Which bridge, inaugurated in June 2025, is the world's highest railway arch bridge?
quiz.solution: The Chenab Bridge in Reasi district stands 359 metres above the river; Anji Khad is India's first cable-stayed rail bridge.

quiz.q: Which company signed a Rs 511 crore deal with ISRO for SSLV technology transfer in June 2025?
quiz.solution: HAL became India's third rocket maker under the first full rocket technology transfer to an Indian company.

quiz.q: What was India's rank in the UN Sustainable Development Report 2025?
quiz.solution: India ranked 99th of 193, entering the top 100 for the first time; Finland topped.

quiz.q: Who was elected the first woman President of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank?
quiz.solution: Zou Jiayi succeeds Jin Liqun as AIIB President from January 2026.

items.headline: Navy receives stealth frigate Udaygiri
items.detail: The Navy received Udaygiri, the second Project 17A frigate built by Mazagon Dock. It is the 100th warship designed by the Navy's Warship Design Bureau.

items.headline: 10th Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting held in the USA
items.detail: EAM S. Jaishankar attended the 10th Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting in the USA during his visit from June 30 to July 2, 2025. The 'Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission' was launched.
examFacts: New initiative: Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission

items.headline: DAC approves proposals worth Rs 1.05 lakh crore
items.detail: The Defence Acquisition Council approved 10 proposals worth Rs 1.05 lakh crore, including QRSAM systems and mine countermeasure vessels.

items.headline: India gets WOAH equine disease-free compartment
items.detail: A World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) equine disease-free compartment was secured at the RVC Centre, Meerut.
examFacts: WOAH equine disease-free compartment: RVC Centre, Meerut

items.headline: India-Australia undersea surveillance research partnership
items.detail: India and Australia began a three-year joint research programme on undersea surveillance.

items.headline: India rejoins Unicode Consortium
items.detail: India rejoined the Unicode Consortium, the body that sets standards for digital text in world scripts.

items.headline: Gujarat becomes third state with over 1 crore investors
items.detail: Gujarat became the third state in India where the number of demat investors crossed 1 crore.
examFacts: Gujarat: 3rd state with over 1 crore investors

items.headline: Bengaluru City University renamed after Manmohan Singh
items.detail: Bengaluru City University was renamed Dr. Manmohan Singh City University in honour of the former Prime Minister.
examFacts: Renamed: Dr. Manmohan Singh City University

items.headline: 3I/ATLAS confirmed as third interstellar object
items.detail: 3I/ATLAS was confirmed as the third known interstellar object seen in our solar system.

items.headline: PM Modi receives top honours in Ghana and Trinidad and Tobago
items.detail: During his five-nation tour from July 2-9, 2025, PM Modi received the 'Officer of the Order of the Star of Ghana' and the 'Order of the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago'. His visit to Argentina was the first by an Indian PM in 57 years.
examFacts: Ghana honour: Officer of the Order of the Star of Ghana
First Indian PM visit to Argentina in 57 years

items.headline: Carlsen wins SuperUnited Zagreb chess
items.detail: Magnus Carlsen won the SuperUnited Rapid and Blitz tournament in Zagreb. World champion D. Gukesh finished third.

items.headline: Hnahthial tops NITI Aayog's North East District SDG Index

items.detail: According to IATA, India is the fifth largest aviation market in the world with 211 million passengers.

items.headline: Moldova becomes 107th member of International Solar Alliance
items.detail: Moldova joined the International Solar Alliance (ISA) as its 107th member country.

items.headline: Punjab first state to empanel sign language interpreters
items.detail: Punjab became the first state to empanel sign language interpreters to help people with hearing and speech disabilities.
examFacts: First state to empanel sign language interpreters: Punjab

items.headline: Philippines President Marcos makes state visit to India
items.detail: Philippines President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. visited India from August 4-8, 2025. The two countries raised ties to a Strategic Partnership and signed 14 MoUs. India and the Philippines also held their first bilateral maritime cooperative activity in the South China Sea.

items.headline: ISRO's HOPE analog mission held in Ladakh
items.detail: ISRO carried out the HOPE analog space mission at Tso Kar in Ladakh from August 1-10, 2025.
examFacts: HOPE analog mission: Tso Kar, Ladakh

items.headline: New rain snake species found in Mizoram
items.detail: Researchers from Mizoram University found a new rain snake species, Smithophis leptofasciatus (narrow-banded rain snake), in Mizoram. The genus Smithophis now has five known species.

items.headline: India nominates Sarnath for UNESCO World Heritage List
items.detail: India nominated Sarnath near Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, for the UNESCO World Heritage List in the 2025-26 cycle. It is one of the four most sacred Buddhist sites.

items.headline: AU Small Finance Bank gets nod to become universal bank
items.detail: RBI gave in-principle approval to AU Small Finance Bank to convert into a universal bank. It is the first such approval in 11 years.
examFacts: AU SFB: in-principle nod for universal bank

items.headline: Satnavri becomes India's first smart intelligent village
items.detail: Satnavri in Nagpur district, Maharashtra became India's first 'smart intelligent village', with drone farming, smart irrigation and digital services for its 1,800 residents.
examFacts: First smart intelligent village: Satnavri, Nagpur, Maharashtra

items.headline: Skyroot tests Kalam-1200 solid rocket motor
items.detail: Skyroot Aerospace carried out a static fire test of its Kalam-1200 solid rocket motor at Sriharikota. The motor is 11 metres long and carries 30 tonnes of propellant.

items.headline: Rishabh Yadav wins India's first individual archery medal at World Games
items.detail: Rishabh Yadav won bronze in men's individual compound archery at the World Games 2025 in Chengdu, China. It is India's first individual archery medal at the World Games.

items.headline: Defence production hits record Rs 1.51 lakh crore in FY25
items.detail: India's defence production reached a record Rs 1.51 lakh crore in FY25, 18% higher than the previous year. Defence exports rose to Rs 23,622 crore.
examFacts: FY25 defence production: Rs 1.51 lakh crore

items.headline: India qualify for AFC U-20 Women's Asian Cup after 20 years
items.detail: India's U-20 women's football team qualified for the AFC U-20 Women's Asian Cup 2026 for the first time in 20 years, after beating Myanmar 1-0 in Yangon. Thailand will host the 2026 event.
examFacts: Qualified: AFC U-20 Women's Asian Cup 2026

items.headline: Retail inflation falls to 1.55% in July
items.detail: CPI retail inflation fell to 1.55% in July 2025, the lowest in about eight years. Food inflation stood at 1.76%.

items.headline: India's solar module manufacturing capacity crosses 100 GW
items.detail: India's solar PV module manufacturing capacity crossed 100 GW, up from 2.3 GW in 2014, according to the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.

items.headline: S. Rohith Krishna becomes India's 89th Grandmaster
items.detail: S. Rohith Krishna, 19, from Tamil Nadu, became India's 89th chess Grandmaster.
examFacts: India's 89th GM: S. Rohith Krishna (Tamil Nadu)

items.headline: India's first hydrogen train completes load trials
items.detail: India's first hydrogen-powered train completed load tests in Chennai. It will run on the 89 km Jind-Sonipat route in Haryana.

items.headline: PLFS: unemployment rate 5.4% in April-June quarter
items.detail: The Periodic Labour Force Survey showed an unemployment rate of 5.4% in the April-June 2025 quarter and 5.2% in July 2025.

items.headline: Dwarka Expressway and UER-II opened in Delhi
items.detail: The Delhi section of the Dwarka Expressway and the Urban Extension Road-II (UER-II), projects worth about Rs 11,000 crore, were inaugurated.
examFacts: Projects: Dwarka Expressway (Delhi section) and UER-II

items.headline: WHO declares Nepal free of rubella
items.detail: WHO declared Nepal free of rubella. Nepal is the sixth country in the WHO South-East Asia Region to reach this goal.

items.headline: India and EAEU sign terms for free trade talks
items.detail: India and the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) signed the Terms of Reference in Moscow to start FTA negotiations. Their trade reached USD 69 billion in 2024.

items.headline: Jaishankar co-chairs 26th India-Russia IRIGC-TEC
items.detail: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar visited Moscow from August 19-21, 2025 for the 26th session of the India-Russia Inter-Governmental Commission (IRIGC-TEC). The two sides aim for USD 100 billion trade by 2030.

items.headline: GoM backs two-slab GST structure
items.detail: The Group of Ministers chaired by Bihar Deputy CM Samrat Choudhary accepted the proposal to replace the four GST slabs with two: 5% for merit goods and 18% for standard items.

items.headline: India wins 4 golds at astronomy olympiad in Mumbai
items.detail: The 18th International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics was held in Mumbai from August 11-21, 2025 with over 300 students from 64 countries. India won 4 gold medals and 1 silver.

items.headline: Income-Tax Act, 2025 gets President's assent
items.detail: President Droupadi Murmu gave assent to the Income-Tax Act, 2025, which will come into force on April 1, 2026. It cuts sections from 819 to 536 and chapters from 47 to 23.

items.headline: Rajit Punhani appointed FSSAI CEO
items.detail: Rajit Punhani, a 1991-batch IAS officer, was appointed CEO of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, succeeding G. Kamala V. Rao.

items.headline: India elected to chair AIBD
items.detail: India was elected chair of the Asia-Pacific Institute for Broadcasting Development (AIBD) at its 23rd General Conference in Phuket, Thailand, held August 19-21, 2025.

items.headline: Online Gaming Act 2025 bans online money games
items.detail: President Droupadi Murmu gave assent to the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Bill, 2025, introduced in the Lok Sabha by Ashwini Vaishnaw on August 20. Offering online money games can bring up to 3 years in jail and a fine of Rs 1 crore.
examFacts: Penalty: up to 3 years and Rs 1 crore fine

items.headline: Nepal joins International Big Cat Alliance as 13th member
items.detail: Nepal became the 13th member of the India-led International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA). The alliance works to protect seven big cat species and is headquartered in New Delhi.

items.headline: DRDO conducts first flight tests of IADWS
items.detail: DRDO carried out the first flight tests of the Integrated Air Defence Weapon System (IADWS) off the Odisha coast. The system combines QRSAM, VSHORADS and a laser-based directed energy weapon.

items.headline: NorthEast United win 134th Durand Cup
items.detail: NorthEast United FC beat Diamond Harbour FC 6-1 in the final of the 134th Durand Cup in Kolkata. Alaaeddine Ajaraie won both the Golden Player and Golden Boot awards.

items.headline: India to supply fortified rice to World Food Programme
items.detail: India and the World Food Programme signed an agreement for India to supply up to 200,000 metric tonnes of fortified rice over five years.
examFacts: Fortified rice: up to 2 lakh tonnes over 5 years

items.headline: PM SVANidhi extended till March 2030
items.detail: The PM SVANidhi scheme for street vendors was extended till March 31, 2030 with an outlay of Rs 7,332 crore. Loan limits were raised to Rs 15,000, Rs 25,000 and Rs 50,000 for the three tranches.

items.headline: INS Udaygiri and INS Himgiri commissioned together
items.detail: The Navy commissioned the frigates INS Udaygiri (built by MDL) and INS Himgiri (built by GRSE) at Visakhapatnam. They are the 100th and 101st warships designed in-house by the Navy.
examFacts: INS Udaygiri: MDL; INS Himgiri: GRSE

items.headline: Goa to host FIDE World Cup 2025
items.detail: Goa was chosen to host the FIDE World Cup from October 30 to November 27, 2025, with 206 players and a prize fund of USD 2 million.

items.headline: Urjit Patel named IMF Executive Director
items.detail: Former RBI Governor Urjit Patel was appointed Executive Director at the International Monetary Fund for three years.

items.headline: UDISE+ 2024-25: teachers cross 1 crore
items.detail: The UDISE+ 2024-25 report showed that the number of school teachers crossed 1 crore for the first time. School enrolment fell by 11 lakh to 24.69 crore.

items.headline: Rajeev Shukla becomes interim BCCI President
items.detail: Rajeev Shukla became interim President of the BCCI after Roger Binny stepped down on turning 70.

items.headline: Sundarbans becomes India's second largest tiger reserve
items.detail: The NBWL Standing Committee approved adding the Matla, Raidighi and Ramganga ranges to the Sundarbans Tiger Reserve. Its area rises to about 3,629.57 sq km, second only to Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve.

items.headline: AQLI 2025: air pollution cuts Indian life expectancy by 3.5 years
items.detail: The Air Quality Life Index 2025 said air pollution reduces the average life expectancy of Indians by 3.5 years.
examFacts: Life expectancy lost to air pollution: 3.5 years

items.headline: EY sees India as second largest economy by PPP by 2038
items.detail: An EY report projected that India will become the world's second largest economy by purchasing power parity by 2038, with a GDP of USD 34.2 trillion.

items.headline: Banking Laws (Amendment) Act provisions come into force
items.detail: Key provisions of the Banking Laws (Amendment) Act, 2025 came into force on August 1, 2025. The limit for 'substantial interest' in a bank was raised from Rs 5 lakh to Rs 2 crore, and the tenure of directors in cooperative banks was extended to 10 years.
examFacts: 'Substantial interest' limit: Rs 5 lakh raised to Rs 2 crore
Cooperative bank directors: tenure up to 10 years

items.headline: Lt Gen Pushpendra Singh becomes Vice Chief of Army Staff
items.detail: Lieutenant General Pushpendra Singh took over as the Vice Chief of the Army Staff on August 1, 2025.
examFacts: New VCOAS: Lt Gen Pushpendra Singh (from August 1, 2025)

items.headline: Vice Admiral Sanjay Vatsayan is 47th Vice Chief of Naval Staff
items.detail: Vice Admiral Sanjay Vatsayan took charge as the 47th Vice Chief of the Naval Staff on August 1, 2025.
examFacts: 47th Vice Chief of Naval Staff: Vice Adm Sanjay Vatsayan

items.headline: 71st National Film Awards: '12th Fail' is Best Feature Film
items.detail: The 71st National Film Awards were announced on August 1, 2025. '12th Fail' won Best Feature Film, and the Best Actor award was shared by Vikrant Massey and Shah Rukh Khan.
examFacts: Best Actor (shared): Vikrant Massey and Shah Rukh Khan

items.headline: A. Rajarajan takes charge as VSSC Director
items.detail: A. Rajarajan became Director of ISRO's Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC) on August 1, 2025.

items.headline: New UPI rules cap balance checks at 50 a day
items.detail: New UPI usage rules came into effect on August 1, 2025. Users can check their account balance up to 50 times a day on each UPI app.
examFacts: UPI balance enquiry: 50 per app per day (from August 1, 2025)

items.headline: 20th PM-KISAN instalment released from Varanasi
items.detail: PM Modi released the 20th instalment of PM-KISAN from Varanasi on August 2, 2025. About Rs 20,500 crore was sent to around 9.7 crore farmers.

items.headline: Lando Norris wins Hungarian GP, McLaren's 200th win
items.detail: Lando Norris won the Hungarian Grand Prix on August 3, 2025. It was McLaren's 200th Formula 1 victory.

items.headline: Former Jharkhand CM Shibu Soren dies at 81
items.detail: Shibu Soren, the Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM) leader who served three times as Chief Minister of Jharkhand, died on August 4, 2025 at the age of 81.

items.headline: India-England Anderson-Tendulkar Trophy drawn 2-2
items.detail: The five-Test Anderson-Tendulkar Trophy between India and England ended 2-2 on August 4, 2025. Shubman Gill scored 754 runs, and Gill and Harry Brook were named joint Players of the Series.
examFacts: Joint Players of the Series: Gill and Brook

items.headline: Former Governor Satyapal Malik dies at 79
items.detail: Former Governor Satyapal Malik died on August 5, 2025 at the age of 79.

items.headline: DAC clears proposals worth Rs 67,000 crore
items.detail: The Defence Acquisition Council cleared capital acquisition proposals worth about Rs 67,000 crore on August 5, 2025.

items.headline: Gujarat is India's top exporting state
items.detail: An FIEO analysis of DGCIS data showed Gujarat as the top exporting state with exports of Rs 9.83 lakh crore, or 26.6% of the total. Maharashtra was second with Rs 5.57 lakh crore.

items.headline: Jensen Huang tops Fortune's most powerful business leaders
items.detail: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang topped Fortune's list of the 100 Most Powerful People in Business. Mukesh Ambani was ranked 56th.

items.headline: PM inaugurates Kartavya Bhavan-3
items.detail: PM Modi inaugurated Kartavya Bhavan-3 in New Delhi.

items.headline: 80th anniversary of Hiroshima and Nagasaki bombings
items.detail: Hiroshima Day on August 6 and Nagasaki Day on August 9, 2025 marked 80 years since the USA dropped atomic bombs on the two Japanese cities in 1945.

items.headline: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.50%
items.detail: The RBI Monetary Policy Committee met from August 4-6, 2025 and unanimously kept the repo rate at 5.50% with a neutral stance. The SDF rate stayed at 5.25% and the MSF rate at 5.75%.

items.headline: MoSPI proposes new base years for GDP, IIP and CPI
items.detail: MoSPI proposed to revise the base year of GDP and IIP to 2022-23 and the base year of CPI to 2024, to better capture changes in the economy.

items.headline: Army inducts minefield marking equipment MMME Mk-II
items.detail: The Indian Army inducted the Mechanical Minefield Marking Equipment Mk-II on August 6, 2025. It was developed by DRDO's R&DE(E) and built by BEML on a TATRA 6x6 vehicle.
examFacts: MMME Mk-II: developed by DRDO's R&DE(E)

items.headline: 11th National Handloom Day observed
items.detail: The 11th National Handloom Day was observed on August 7, 2025. The day was first observed in 2015, when PM Modi launched it in Chennai.

items.headline: Myanmar's former acting President Myint Swe dies
items.detail: Myint Swe, who was Myanmar's acting President from 2021 to 2024 after the military coup, died in Naypyitaw on August 7, 2025 at the age of 74.
examFacts: Myint Swe: acting President of Myanmar, 2021-2024

items.headline: M.S. Swaminathan centenary conference and first global award
items.detail: PM Modi inaugurated the M.S. Swaminathan Centenary Conference at Pusa, New Delhi (August 7-9, 2025) on the theme 'Evergreen Revolution - Path to Bio-Happiness'. He released a Rs 100 coin, and Nigerian scientist Prof. Ademola A. Adenle received the first Global M.S. Swaminathan Award.
examFacts: First Global M.S. Swaminathan Award: Prof. Ademola A. Adenle (Nigeria)

items.headline: Cabinet approves MERITE scheme for technical education
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved the MERITE scheme with an outlay of Rs 4,200 crore, including a Rs 2,100 crore World Bank loan. It will cover 275 technical institutions from 2025-26 to 2029-30.

items.headline: Rs 300 LPG subsidy continued under Ujjwala Yojana
items.detail: The Cabinet approved Rs 12,000 crore to continue the Rs 300 subsidy per 14.2 kg cylinder for PM Ujjwala Yojana users, for up to 9 refills a year. It also approved Rs 30,000 crore to IOCL, BPCL and HPCL for losses on domestic LPG.
examFacts: PMUY subsidy: Rs 300 per cylinder, up to 9 refills a year

items.headline: Special development packages for Assam and Tripura
items.detail: The Cabinet approved special development packages for Assam and Tripura with a central outlay of Rs 4,250 crore, including Rs 3,000 crore for ULFA-affected areas.
examFacts: Includes Rs 3,000 crore for ULFA-affected areas

items.headline: GeM marks 9th Foundation Day
items.detail: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) celebrated its 9th Foundation Day on August 9, 2025 on the theme 'Ease, Access and Inclusion'. Its gross merchandise value in FY25 was Rs 5.4 lakh crore.
examFacts: GeM FY25 GMV: Rs 5.4 lakh crore

items.headline: International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples
items.detail: The day was observed on August 9, 2025 with the theme 'Indigenous Peoples and Artificial Intelligence: Defending Rights, Shaping Futures'.

items.headline: India's first animal stem cell biobank opens in Hyderabad
items.detail: Union Minister Jitendra Singh inaugurated India's first Animal Stem Cell Biobank at the National Institute of Animal Biotechnology (NIAB), Hyderabad on August 9, 2025.
examFacts: First Animal Stem Cell Biobank: NIAB, Hyderabad

items.headline: Three Vande Bharat trains and Bengaluru Metro Yellow Line launched
items.detail: On August 10, 2025, Vande Bharat trains were launched on the Ajni (Nagpur)-Pune, Bengaluru-Belagavi and Katra-Amritsar routes. The Bengaluru Metro Yellow Line was opened and the foundation of Metro Phase-3 was laid.
examFacts: New Vande Bharat routes: Ajni-Pune, Bengaluru-Belagavi, Katra-Amritsar

items.headline: Asiatic lion count rises to 891
items.detail: On World Lion Day (August 10), it was noted that the Asiatic lion population rose from 674 in 2020 to 891 in 2025, a 32.2% increase in five years.

items.headline: Cabinet approves four new semiconductor units
items.detail: The Cabinet approved four new semiconductor units in Punjab, Odisha and Andhra Pradesh with an investment of Rs 4,600 crore. This takes the total under the India Semiconductor Mission to 10 projects worth about Rs 1.60 lakh crore.

items.headline: World Elephant Day and International Youth Day
items.detail: World Elephant Day was observed on August 12, 2025, with the national event held in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. International Youth Day, also on August 12, had the theme 'Local Youth Actions for the SDGs and Beyond'.

items.headline: Cabinet clears Lucknow Metro Phase-1B and Tato-II hydro project
items.detail: The Cabinet approved Lucknow Metro Phase-1B (11.165 km, 12 stations, Rs 5,801 crore) and the 700 MW Tato-II hydroelectric project in Shi Yomi district, Arunachal Pradesh (Rs 8,146.21 crore).

items.headline: RBI moves cheque clearing to continuous mode
items.detail: RBI announced that cheques under the Cheque Truncation System will be cleared continuously on the same day instead of in a two-day cycle. Phase I starts on October 4, 2025 and Phase II on January 3, 2026.
examFacts: CTS continuous clearing Phase I: October 4, 2025

items.headline: Partition Horrors Remembrance Day
items.detail: The fifth Partition Horrors Remembrance Day was observed on August 14, 2025 to remember the people affected by the 1947 Partition. The day was declared in 2021.

items.headline: Jal Jeevan Mission completes six years
items.detail: Under the Jal Jeevan Mission, more than 15.69 crore rural households, or 81% of rural India, have been connected to tap water.

items.headline: SLINEX-2025 held in Colombo
items.detail: The 12th edition of the India-Sri Lanka naval exercise SLINEX was held in Colombo from August 14-18, 2025.

items.headline: Navy receives third survey vessel Ikshak
items.detail: GRSE delivered Ikshak, the third Survey Vessel (Large), to the Indian Navy. It is the first ship of its class with accommodation for women officers and sailors.

items.headline: PM's 12th Independence Day speech announces new missions
items.detail: On the 79th Independence Day, PM Modi gave his 12th straight speech from the Red Fort, lasting 103 minutes. He announced the PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana, Mission Sudarshan Chakra to be completed by 2035, and a High-Powered Demography Mission.
examFacts: 79th Independence Day: 12th consecutive speech by PM Modi

items.headline: Nagaland Governor La. Ganesan dies at 80
items.detail: La. Ganesan, the Governor of Nagaland, died in Chennai on August 15, 2025 at the age of 80. Ajay Kumar Bhalla, a 1984-batch IAS officer, was given additional charge as Governor of Nagaland.

items.headline: PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana portal launched
items.detail: The PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana has a budget of Rs 99,446 crore and aims to create 3.5 crore jobs from August 2025 to July 2027. A portal for employer registration was launched.

items.headline: World Humanitarian Day observed
items.detail: World Humanitarian Day was observed on August 19, 2025. It marks the 2003 bombing of the UN office in Baghdad and was first observed in 2009.

items.headline: CCS approves 97 more Tejas Mk1A jets
items.detail: The Cabinet Committee on Security approved the purchase of 97 Light Combat Aircraft Tejas Mk1A for the Indian Air Force from HAL at about Rs 62,000 crore. The jets will have 65% indigenous content.

items.headline: Cabinet clears Odisha ring road and Kota-Bundi airport
items.detail: The Cabinet approved a 110.875 km six-lane Capital Region Ring Road in Odisha (Rs 8,307.74 crore) and a greenfield airport at Kota-Bundi, Rajasthan (Rs 1,507 crore).
examFacts: Odisha Capital Region Ring Road: 110.875 km

items.headline: Agni-5 successfully test-fired
items.detail: India successfully test-fired the Agni-5 intermediate-range ballistic missile from the Integrated Test Range, Chandipur, Odisha on August 20, 2025. It has a range of over 5,000 km.

items.headline: World Mosquito Day and Sadbhavana Diwas
items.detail: World Mosquito Day on August 20 marks Sir Ronald Ross's 1897 discovery that female Anopheles mosquitoes spread malaria. Sadbhavana Diwas was also observed on the birth anniversary of Rajiv Gandhi.

items.headline: Khelo India Water Sports Festival held at Dal Lake
items.detail: The Khelo India Water Sports Festival was held at Dal Lake, Srinagar from August 21-23, 2025. Madhya Pradesh topped the table with 10 golds. The mascot was a Himalayan Kingfisher.

items.headline: Industrialist Lord Swraj Paul dies at 94
items.detail: UK-based industrialist Lord Swraj Paul, founder of the Caparo Group and a member of the House of Lords, died on August 21, 2025 at the age of 94. He received the Padma Bhushan in 1983.
examFacts: Swraj Paul: founder of Caparo Group

items.headline: Indranil Bhattacharyya joins RBI Monetary Policy Committee
items.detail: RBI Executive Director Indranil Bhattacharyya was named an ex-officio member of the Monetary Policy Committee, replacing Rajiv Ranjan.

items.headline: Former CPI General Secretary Suravaram Sudhakar Reddy dies
items.detail: Suravaram Sudhakar Reddy, who became General Secretary of the Communist Party of India in 2012 and was twice MP from Nalgonda, died on August 22, 2025 at the age of 83.

items.headline: National Space Day celebrated
items.detail: National Space Day on August 23 marks the Chandrayaan-3 landing of 2023. The 2025 theme was 'Aryabhatta to Gaganyaan: Ancient Wisdom to Infinite Possibilities'.

items.headline: All India Speakers' Conference marks Vitthalbhai Patel centenary
items.detail: Amit Shah inaugurated the All India Speakers' Conference at the Delhi Assembly on August 24, 2025. It marked 100 years since Vitthalbhai Patel became the first elected Indian Speaker.
examFacts: First elected Indian Speaker: Vitthalbhai Patel (1925)

items.headline: Anish Dayal Singh appointed Deputy NSA
items.detail: Former CRPF and ITBP chief Anish Dayal Singh, a 1988-batch IPS officer, was appointed Deputy National Security Advisor.

items.headline: Fiji PM Rabuka visits India
items.detail: Fiji Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabuka visited India from August 24-26, 2025, and the two sides signed 9 MoUs.

items.headline: National Biofoundry Network launched
items.detail: Union Minister Jitendra Singh launched India's first National Biofoundry Network of six institutions, along with the BioE3 Challenge for young people.

items.headline: PM Jan Dhan Yojana completes 11 years
items.detail: PM Jan Dhan Yojana completed 11 years on August 28, 2025, with 56.16 crore accounts holding deposits of Rs 2,67,756 crore.

items.headline: NARI 2025 names Kohima safest city for women
items.detail: The NARI 2025 report gave India a women's safety score of 65%. Kohima, Visakhapatnam and Bhubaneswar were among the safest cities.

items.headline: India joins Exercise Bright Star in Egypt
items.detail: India sent more than 700 personnel to the 19th edition of the multinational Exercise Bright Star in Egypt, held from August 28 to September 10, 2025.

items.headline: National Sports Day celebrated
items.detail: National Sports Day was observed from August 29-31, 2025 with the theme 'Ek Ghanta, Khel ke Maidan Main'.

items.headline: State Energy Efficiency Index 2024 released
items.detail: The State Energy Efficiency Index 2024 assessed 36 States and UTs. Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, Assam and Tripura were top performers.
examFacts: Top performers include Maharashtra and Andhra Pradesh

items.headline: Supreme Court reaches full strength of 34 judges
items.detail: Justices Alok Aradhe and Vipul Manubhai Pancholi took oath as Supreme Court judges on August 29, 2025, taking the court to its full sanctioned strength of 34.

items.headline: PM Modi attends 15th India-Japan Annual Summit
items.detail: PM Modi visited Japan on August 29-30, 2025 for the 15th India-Japan Annual Summit. Japan pledged investment of JPY 10 trillion (about USD 65 billion) over 10 years.
examFacts: Japan investment pledge: JPY 10 trillion over 10 years

items.headline: National Small Industry Day observed
items.detail: National Small Industry Day is observed on August 30 to mark the small-scale industries policy announced on August 30, 2000 by PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

items.headline: India top Asian Shooting Championship with 99 medals
items.detail: India won 99 medals, including 50 gold, 26 silver and 23 bronze, at the Asian Shooting Championship held in Shymkent, Kazakhstan from August 16-30, 2025.

items.headline: India win 40 medals at Commonwealth Weightlifting Championships
items.detail: India won 40 medals (27 gold, 10 silver, 3 bronze) at the 30th Commonwealth Weightlifting Championships in Ahmedabad from August 24-30, 2025. Mirabai Chanu won gold in the women's 48 kg category.

items.headline: Educate Girls is first Indian organisation to win Magsaysay Award
items.detail: Educate Girls, founded by Safeena Husain in 2007, was announced on August 31, 2025 as a winner of the Ramon Magsaysay Award. It is the first Indian organisation to win the award.
examFacts: Educate Girls: founded 2007 by Safeena Husain
First Indian organisation to win the Magsaysay Award

items.headline: Oscar Piastri wins Dutch Grand Prix
items.detail: Oscar Piastri of McLaren won the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort on August 31, 2025, with Max Verstappen second.

quiz.q: Which film won Best Feature Film at the 71st National Film Awards announced in August 2025?
quiz.solution: '12th Fail' won Best Feature Film; the Best Actor award was shared by Vikrant Massey and Shah Rukh Khan.

quiz.q: At what level did the RBI keep the repo rate in its August 2025 policy?
quiz.solution: The MPC unanimously kept the repo rate at 5.50% with a neutral stance.

quiz.q: How many Tejas Mk1A jets did the CCS approve in August 2025?
quiz.solution: The CCS approved 97 Tejas Mk1A jets from HAL for about Rs 62,000 crore.

quiz.q: After its August 2025 expansion, the Sundarbans Tiger Reserve is second in size only to which reserve?
quiz.solution: Sundarbans grew to about 3,629.57 sq km, behind Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve.

quiz.q: From which date will the Income-Tax Act, 2025 come into force?
quiz.solution: The Act received assent in August 2025 and takes effect on April 1, 2026.

quiz.q: Who founded Educate Girls, the first Indian organisation to win the Ramon Magsaysay Award?
quiz.solution: Safeena Husain founded Educate Girls in 2007.

quiz.q: Where was the Asian Shooting Championship 2025, in which India won 99 medals, held?
quiz.solution: India won 99 medals, including 50 gold, in Shymkent, Kazakhstan.

quiz.q: Nepal became which member of the International Big Cat Alliance in August 2025?
quiz.solution: Nepal became the 13th member of the India-led IBCA.

quiz.q: What was the Asiatic lion population reported in 2025?
quiz.solution: The count rose from 674 in 2020 to 891 in 2025.

quiz.q: How much investment did Japan pledge to India at the 15th Annual Summit in August 2025?
quiz.solution: Japan pledged JPY 10 trillion (about USD 65 billion) over 10 years.

items.headline: PM attends 25th SCO Summit in Tianjin
items.detail: PM Modi visited China from August 31 to September 1, 2025 for the 25th SCO Summit in Tianjin, his first official visit to China since 2018. Laos was given SCO dialogue partner status.

items.headline: Manufacturing PMI hits 17-year high of 59.3
items.detail: India's Manufacturing PMI rose to 59.3 in August 2025, its highest level since 2008.

items.headline: UPI crosses 20 billion monthly transactions
items.detail: UPI crossed 20 billion transactions in a single month for the first time in August 2025, with 20.01 billion transactions worth Rs 24.85 lakh crore.

items.headline: CAA cut-off date extended to December 31, 2024
items.detail: The Ministry of Home Affairs extended the cut-off entry date under the Citizenship Amendment Act framework to December 31, 2024, from December 31, 2014.
examFacts: New CAA cut-off entry date: 31 December 2024 (earlier 31 December 2014)

items.headline: Cabinet approves Rs 1,500 crore critical mineral recycling scheme
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved a Rs 1,500 crore scheme to recycle critical minerals from sources such as e-waste and lithium-ion battery scrap, for FY 2025-26 to FY 2030-31.
examFacts: Critical mineral recycling scheme: Rs 1,500 crore

items.headline: GST Council approves two-slab structure of 5% and 18%
items.detail: The 56th GST Council, chaired by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, approved a two-tier GST structure of 5% and 18%, effective September 22, 2025, along with a special 40% rate for select items.

items.headline: SRS 2023: infant mortality rate falls to 25
items.detail: The Sample Registration System 2023 report showed India's infant mortality rate fell to 25 per 1,000 live births and the total fertility rate fell to 1.9.

items.headline: IIT Madras tops NIRF 2025 for seventh straight year
items.detail: IIT Madras topped the overall NIRF 2025 rankings for the seventh consecutive year, followed by IISc Bengaluru and IIT Bombay.
examFacts: NIRF 2025 overall: IIT Madras 1st (7th year in a row)

items.headline: Anutin Charnvirakul elected Thailand's 32nd Prime Minister
items.detail: Anutin Charnvirakul of the Bhumjaithai Party was elected Thailand's 32nd PM with 311 votes. He succeeded Paetongtarn Shinawatra, who was dismissed by the Constitutional Court.

items.headline: Anuparna Roy wins Best Director at Venice Orizzonti
items.detail: Indian filmmaker Anuparna Roy won Best Director in the Orizzonti section of the 82nd Venice Film Festival for her debut feature 'Songs of Forgotten Trees'.
examFacts: Anuparna Roy: Best Director, Orizzonti (82nd Venice Film Festival)

items.headline: India and Israel sign Bilateral Investment Treaty
items.detail: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman and Israel's Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich signed a Bilateral Investment Treaty in New Delhi. Israel became the first OECD member state to sign such an agreement with India.

items.headline: India's first bamboo-based bio-refinery at Numaligarh
items.detail: India's first bamboo-based bio-refinery at Numaligarh, Assam was inaugurated on September 14. It can produce 49,000 tonnes of bioethanol per year.

items.headline: Sushila Karki becomes Nepal's first woman Prime Minister
items.detail: Former Chief Justice Sushila Karki was sworn in as Nepal's interim Prime Minister, the first woman to hold the post. General elections were set for March 5, 2026.
examFacts: Nepal's first woman PM: Sushila Karki (interim)

items.headline: Samudra Pradakshina: first tri-service all-women circumnavigation
items.detail: Rajnath Singh flagged off Samudra Pradakshina from Mumbai, the world's first tri-service all-women circumnavigation, with 10 women officers aboard IASV Triveni.
examFacts: Crew: 10 women officers from Army, Navy and Air Force

items.headline: Rs 100 coin for Bhupen Hazarika centenary
items.detail: During his Assam visit on September 13-14, PM Modi released a Rs 100 commemorative coin for Dr. Bhupen Hazarika's 100th birth anniversary.

items.headline: Navy commissions INS Aravali in Gurugram
items.detail: The Indian Navy commissioned the naval base INS Aravali in Gurugram, Haryana. Its motto is 'Maritime Security through Collaboration'.

items.headline: India finishes 3rd at World Boxing Championships
items.detail: At the World Boxing Championships in Liverpool from September 4-14, India won 4 medals and finished third. Minakshi Hooda and Jaismine Lamboria won gold.
examFacts: India's gold medallists: Minakshi Hooda, Jaismine Lamboria

items.headline: Vaishali wins FIDE Women's Grand Swiss
items.detail: R. Vaishali won the FIDE Women's Grand Swiss in Samarkand with 8 points from 11. Anish Giri of the Netherlands won the Open section.
examFacts: FIDE Women's Grand Swiss 2025: R. Vaishali

items.headline: India ranks 38th in Global Innovation Index 2025
items.detail: India rose to 38th in the Global Innovation Index 2025, up from 39th. Switzerland ranked first, followed by Sweden and the USA.

items.headline: Mauritius PM Ramgoolam visits India
items.detail: Mauritius PM Ramgoolam visited India from September 9-16, 2025. India announced a special economic package worth USD 680 million for Mauritius.
examFacts: India's package for Mauritius: USD 680 million

items.headline: Central Zone wins Duleep Trophy
items.detail: Central Zone, captained by Rajat Patidar, beat South Zone by 6 wickets to win the Duleep Trophy, their 7th title.

items.headline: Mohanlal to receive Dadasaheb Phalke Award
items.detail: Malayalam actor Mohanlal was named for the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2023. He is the second Malayalam film personality to get it, after Adoor Gopalakrishnan.

items.headline: Zorawar light tank unveiled
items.detail: The Zorawar light tank, developed by DRDO and Larsen and Toubro, weighs 25 tonnes and carries a 105 mm gun. Induction is targeted for 2027.
examFacts: Zorawar light tank: DRDO and L&T, 25 tonnes

items.headline: OECD raises India's FY26 growth forecast to 6.7%
items.detail: The OECD raised India's FY26 GDP growth forecast to 6.7% from 6.3%, and projected 6.2% for FY27.

items.headline: UPI launched in Qatar
items.detail: UPI services were launched in Qatar with Qatar National Bank, making Qatar the 8th country to adopt UPI.

items.headline: Agni-Prime test-fired from rail-based launcher
items.detail: India test-fired the Agni-Prime missile from a Rail-Based Mobile Launcher, a first-of-its-kind launch from a specially designed rail platform.
examFacts: Agni-Prime: first launch from a rail-based mobile launcher

items.headline: Rs 62,370 crore deal for 97 Tejas Mk1A jets
items.detail: The Defence Ministry signed a Rs 62,370 crore contract with HAL for 97 Tejas Mk1A fighters, with deliveries from 2027-28. Total Tejas Mk1A orders rose to 180.

items.headline: Maldives becomes 181st IAEA member
items.detail: At the 69th IAEA General Conference in Vienna from September 15-19, the Maldives became the agency's 181st member state.

items.headline: BSNL launches Swadeshi 4G network
items.detail: BSNL's indigenous 4G network was launched at Jharsuguda, Odisha, with 97,500 towers commissioned at a cost of about Rs 37,000 crore.

items.headline: Cold Desert becomes India's 13th UNESCO biosphere reserve
items.detail: The Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve in Lahaul-Spiti, Himachal Pradesh, covering 7,770 sq km, was added to UNESCO's network. It is India's 13th biosphere reserve in the network.
